local Players         = game:GetService("Players")

local DISCORD_URL   = "https://discord.gg/zQbQJH5rMb"
local GATE_SECONDS  = 15
local LOADER_URL    = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ummarxfarooq/mystrix-hub/refs/heads/main/loader"

local uc = {
	Panel     = Color3.fromRGB(10, 8, 8),
	Surface   = Color3.fromRGB(24, 10, 10),

	Muted     = Color3.fromRGB(170, 120, 120),
	On        = Color3.fromRGB(220, 55, 55),
	Discord   = Color3.fromRGB(200, 35, 35),
}

local function make(className, props, parent)
	local inst = Instance.new(className)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do inst[k] = v end
	inst.Parent = parent
	return inst
end

local function corner(parent, radius)
	make("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius) }, parent)
end

local function copyDiscord()
	pcall(function()
		if setclipboard then
			setclipboard(DISCORD_URL)
		elseif toclipboard then
			toclipboard(DISCORD_URL)
		end
	end)
end

	local copyBtn = make("TextButton", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 40),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 198),
		BackgroundColor3 = uc.Discord,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Text = "Copy Discord Invite",
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		TextSize = 14,

-- Variables de configuración (Triángulo con radio 60)
local isLooping = false
local RADIUS = 60 -- Radio de 60 studs
local INITIAL_SPEED = 50
local SPEED_INCREMENT = 100 -- Incrementa 100 cada 1 segundo
local MAX_EXTREME_SPEED = 100000 -- Límite máximo de velocidad en 100,000

-- Función del bucle limpio en triángulo
local function startTriangleLoop()
    task.spawn(function()
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character or LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
        local hrp = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        
        local centerCFrame = hrp.CFrame
        local centerPos = centerCFrame.Position
        
        -- Calculamos los 3 vértices del triángulo equilátero con radio 60
        local vertices = {}
        for i = 0, 2 do
            local angle = math.rad(i * 120)
            local offsetX = math.cos(angle) * RADIUS
            local offsetZ = math.sin(angle) * RADIUS
            table.insert(vertices, centerPos + Vector3.new(offsetX, 0, offsetZ))
        end
        
        local currentIndex = 1
        local currentSpeed = INITIAL_SPEED
        local timeElapsedSinceIncrease = 0
        
        SpeedLabel.Text = "Velocidad: " .. currentSpeed
        
        while isLooping do
            character = LocalPlayer.Character
            hrp = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not hrp then break end
            
            local targetPos = vertices[currentIndex]
            local distance = (targetPos - hrp.Position).Magnitude
            
            local duration = distance / currentSpeed
            if duration < 0.0001 then duration = 0.0001 end
            
            local targetCFrame = CFrame.new(targetPos) * (centerCFrame - centerCFrame.Position)
            local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear)
            local tween = TweenService:Create(hrp, tweenInfo, {CFrame = targetCFrame})
            
            tween:Play()
            
            local elapsed = 0
            while elapsed < duration and isLooping do
                local dt = task.wait()
                elapsed = elapsed + dt
                timeElapsedSinceIncrease = timeElapsedSinceIncrease + dt
                
                if timeElapsedSinceIncrease >= 1 then
                    timeElapsedSinceIncrease = 0
                    if currentSpeed < MAX_EXTREME_SPEED then
                        currentSpeed = currentSpeed + SPEED_INCREMENT
                        SpeedLabel.Text = "Velocidad: " .. currentSpeed
                    end
                end
            end
            
            if not isLooping then
                tween:Cancel()
                break
            end
            
            -- Pasar al siguiente vértice del triángulo (1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 1)
            currentIndex = (currentIndex % 3) + 1
        end
        SpeedLabel.Text = "Velocidad: 50 (Pausado)"
    end)
end

-- Evento del botón de Triángulo
TriangleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    isLooping = not isLooping

        TriangleBtn.Text = "TP Triángulo: ON"
        TriangleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 170)
        TriangleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 55, 45)
        startTriangleLoop()
    else

        TriangleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
        TriangleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 50)
        SpeedLabel.Text = "Velocidad: 50"
    end
end)

------------------------------------------------------------

sound.Parent = SoundService

    local id = tonumber(idBox.Text)
    if not id then
        status.Text = "⚠ Invalid Sound ID"
        status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 120)
        return
    end
    sound:Stop()
    sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. id
    sound.Looped  = true
    sound:Play()
    status.Text = "▶ Playing (loop) - ID: " .. id
    status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 120)
end)

stopBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    sound:Stop()
    status.Text = "■ Stopped"
    status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 120)
end)

------------------------------------------------------------
-- Full close (100% gone)
------------------------------------------------------------
closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    sound:Stop()
    sound:Destroy()
    gui:Destroy()
end)

------------------------------------------------------------
-- Minimize (stays on screen, title bar visible)
------------------------------------------------------------
local minimized       = false
local expandedSize    = frame.Size

minBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    minimized = not minimized
    if minimized then
        frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 28)
        for _, child in ipairs(frame:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("GuiObject") and child ~= title then
                child.Visible = false
            end
        end
        minBtn.Text = "+"
    else
        frame.Size = expandedSize
        for _, child in ipairs(frame:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("GuiObject") then
                child.Visible = true
            end
        end
        minBtn.Text = "-"
    end
end)

------------------------------------------------------------
-- Drag (grab the title bar)
------------------------------------------------------------
local dragging, dragStart, startPos

title.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos  = frame.Position

        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        frame.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end)

-- === PLAYLISTA MUZYCZNA (Przełącza się automatycznie po zakończeniu utworu, w pętli) ===
playlist = {
    "rbxassetid://1845458027",
    "rbxassetid://85362242154153",
    "rbxassetid://99445078556609",
    "rbxassetid://1846458016",
    "rbxassetid://1841443579"
}
currentTrackIndex = 1
musicEnabled = true
trackGeneration = 0

BASE_MUSIC_VOLUME = 1
MUFFLED_MUSIC_VOLUME = 0.88
muffledStateActive = false
muffledSavedVolumes = {}
muffledEqualizers = {}

local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
sound.Name = "KM_Studio_Music"
sound.Volume = BASE_MUSIC_VOLUME
sound.Looped = false

local function getMuffledTargetVolume(snd)
	if snd == sound then
		return MUFFLED_MUSIC_VOLUME
	end
	local orig = muffledSavedVolumes[snd]
	if typeof(orig) == "number" then
		return math.clamp(orig * 0.85, 0.06, 10)
	end
	return nil
end

local function collectPlayingSounds()
	local list = {}
	local seen = {}

	local function addIfPlaying(obj)
		if obj and obj:IsA("Sound") and not seen[obj] then
			seen[obj] = true
			local isActive = false
			pcall(function()
				isActive = obj.IsPlaying or (obj == sound and musicEnabled)
			end)
			if isActive then
				table.insert(list, obj)
			end
		end
	end

	if sound and sound.Parent then
		addIfPlaying(sound)
	end

	for _, container in ipairs({ SoundService, CoreGui, workspace }) do
		pcall(function()
			for _, desc in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do
				if desc:IsA("Sound") and desc.IsPlaying then
					addIfPlaying(desc)
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	local pg = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
	if pg then
		pcall(function()
			for _, desc in ipairs(pg:GetDescendants()) do
				if desc:IsA("Sound") and desc.IsPlaying then
					addIfPlaying(desc)
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	return list
end

local function applyMuffledMusicEffect(enable)
	if musicDeleted then return end
	muffledStateActive = enable

	if enable then
		for _, snd in ipairs(collectPlayingSounds()) do
			pcall(function()
				if muffledSavedVolumes[snd] == nil then
					muffledSavedVolumes[snd] = (snd == sound) and BASE_MUSIC_VOLUME or snd.Volume
				end

				local eq = muffledEqualizers[snd]
				if not eq or not eq.Parent then
					eq = snd:FindFirstChild("KM_Muffled_EQ")
					if not eq then
						eq = Instance.new("EqualizerSoundEffect")
						eq.Name = "KM_Muffled_EQ"
						eq.LowGain = 4.0
						eq.MidGain = -9
						eq.HighGain = -20
						eq.Enabled = true
						eq.Parent = snd
					end
					muffledEqualizers[snd] = eq
				end
				eq.LowGain = 4.0
				eq.MidGain = -9
				eq.HighGain = -20
				eq.Enabled = true

				local targetVol = getMuffledTargetVolume(snd)
				if targetVol then
					TweenService:Create(
						snd,
						TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
						{ Volume = targetVol }
					):Play()
				end
			end)
		end
	else
		for snd, eq in pairs(muffledEqualizers) do
			pcall(function()
				if eq and eq.Parent then
					eq:Destroy()
				end
			end)
			muffledEqualizers[snd] = nil
		end

		for snd, origVol in pairs(muffledSavedVolumes) do
			pcall(function()
				if snd and snd.Parent then
					local restoreVol = (snd == sound) and BASE_MUSIC_VOLUME or origVol
					TweenService:Create(
						snd,
						TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
						{ Volume = restoreVol }
					):Play()
				end
			end)
			muffledSavedVolumes[snd] = nil
		end

		if sound and sound.Parent then
			pcall(function()
				sound.Volume = BASE_MUSIC_VOLUME
			end)
		end
	end
end

local function attachSoundParent()
	if musicDeleted or not sound then return end
	local ok = pcall(function()
		sound.Parent = CoreGui
	end)
	if not ok or not sound.Parent then
		pcall(function()

		end)
	end

local lastTrackSwitchTick = 0
local isSwitchingTrack = false

local function playTrackAtIndex(idx)
	if musicDeleted or not sound or isSwitchingTrack then return end
	isSwitchingTrack = true
	lastTrackSwitchTick = tick()
	trackGeneration = trackGeneration + 1
	local myGen = trackGeneration

	local wrappedIdx = ((idx - 1) % #playlist) + 1
	currentTrackIndex = wrappedIdx
	refreshTrackInfo()

	if sound.Parent == nil then
		attachSoundParent()
	end

	local nextAssetId = playlist[currentTrackIndex] or ""
	pcall(function()
		sound.Looped = false
		sound:Stop()
		sound.SoundId = ""
		sound.TimePosition = 0
		sound.SoundId = nextAssetId
		sound.Volume = muffledStateActive and MUFFLED_MUSIC_VOLUME or BASE_MUSIC_VOLUME
		if musicEnabled and nextAssetId ~= "" then
			sound:Play()
		end
	end)

	task.delay(0.15, function()
		if trackGeneration == myGen and sound and not musicDeleted then
			pcall(function()
				if musicEnabled and not sound.IsPlaying and sound.SoundId == nextAssetId then
					sound.TimePosition = 0
					sound:Play()
				end
			end)
		end
		isSwitchingTrack = false
	end)

	if muffledStateActive then
		task.defer(function()
			applyMuffledMusicEffect(true)
		end)
	end
end

local function triggerNextTrack()
	if musicDeleted or not musicEnabled or isSwitchingTrack then return end
	if (tick() - lastTrackSwitchTick) < 0.45 then return end
	local nextIdx = (currentTrackIndex % #playlist) + 1
	playTrackAtIndex(nextIdx)
end

sound.Ended:Connect(function()
	if musicDeleted or not musicEnabled then return end
	triggerNextTrack()
end)

-- Nadzór końca utworu (także gdy dźwięk nie zdąży się załadować i ma TimeLength == 0 po próbie odtworzenia)
task.spawn(function()
	local zeroLengthTicks = 0
	local lastId = ""
	while true do
		task.wait(0.25)
		if musicDeleted then break end
		pcall(function()
			if not musicEnabled or not sound or isSwitchingTrack then
				zeroLengthTicks = 0
				return
			end

			if sound.SoundId ~= lastId then
				lastId = sound.SoundId
				zeroLengthTicks = 0
			end

			if sound.Parent == nil then
				attachSoundParent()
			end

			if not sound.IsPlaying and sound.SoundId ~= "" and (tick() - lastTrackSwitchTick) > 0.6 then
				sound:Play()
			end

			if muffledStateActive then
				applyMuffledMusicEffect(true)
			end

			local length = sound.TimeLength
			if length > 0 then
				zeroLengthTicks = 0
				if sound.TimePosition >= (length - 0.2) then
					triggerNextTrack()
				end
			elseif sound.IsPlaying then
				zeroLengthTicks = zeroLengthTicks + 1
				if zeroLengthTicks >= 20 then
					zeroLengthTicks = 0
					triggerNextTrack()
				end
			end
		end)
	end
end)

playTrackAtIndex(currentTrackIndex)

local function clearSeasonalEffects()
	for key in pairs(seasonalEffectTokens) do
		seasonalEffectTokens[key] = (seasonalEffectTokens[key] or 0) + 1
	end
	if seasonalContainer and seasonalContainer.Parent then
		for _, child in ipairs(seasonalContainer:GetChildren()) do
			pcall(function() child:Destroy() end)
		end
	end
end

local function spawnSeasonalEffects(effectType)
	clearSeasonalEffects()
	if not effectType or not seasonalContainer or not seasonalContainer.Parent then return end

	local particleGlyphs = {}
	local particleColors = {}
	if effectType == "AUTUMN" then
		particleGlyphs = { "🍂", "🍁" }
		particleColors = { Color3.fromRGB(255, 165, 55), Color3.fromRGB(214, 105, 38), Color3.fromRGB(245, 198, 72) }
	elseif effectType == "WINTER" then
		particleGlyphs = { "❄️", "•" }
		particleColors = { Color3.fromRGB(225, 245, 255), Color3.fromRGB(175, 225, 255) }
	elseif effectType == "SUMMER" then
		particleGlyphs = { "☀️", "✦" }
		particleColors = { Color3.fromRGB(255, 228, 102), Color3.fromRGB(110, 238, 224) }
	end

	for i = 1, 6 do
		local token = (seasonalEffectTokens[i] or 0) + 1
		seasonalEffectTokens[i] = token

		task.spawn(function()
			while seasonalContainer and seasonalContainer.Parent and seasonalEffectTokens[i] == token do
				local pLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
				pLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				pLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
				pLabel.Text = particleGlyphs[((i - 1) % #particleGlyphs) + 1]
				pLabel.TextColor3 = particleColors[((i - 1) % #particleColors) + 1]
				pLabel.TextSize = (effectType == "WINTER") and 11 or 12
				pLabel.TextTransparency = 0.25
				pLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 16)
				local startX = math.clamp(0.08 + ((i - 1) * 0.16) + (math.random(-4, 4) * 0.01), 0.05, 0.88)
				pLabel.Position = UDim2.new(startX, 0, -0.08, 0)
				pLabel.ZIndex = 3
				pLabel.Parent = seasonalContainer

				local driftX = math.clamp(startX + (math.random(-8, 8) * 0.01), 0.04, 0.88)
				local fallTime = math.random(24, 38) / 10
				local moveTween = TweenService:Create(
					pLabel,
					TweenInfo.new(fallTime, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut),
					{
						Position = UDim2.new(driftX, 0, 1.05, 0),
						TextTransparency = 0.85,
						Rotation = math.random(-25, 25)
					}
				)
				moveTween:Play()
				task.wait(fallTime + math.random(2, 7) / 10)
				pcall(function() pLabel:Destroy() end)
			end
		end)
	end
end

local function registerThemedElement(obj, role)
	table.insert(themeRegisteredItems, { obj = obj, role = role })
end

local function updateThemeButtonVisuals()
	local activeDef = THEMES[currentThemeName] or THEMES["NORMAL THEME"]
	for name, btn in pairs(themeButtons) do
		if btn and btn.Parent then
			local isSelected = (name == currentThemeName)
			btn.TextColor3 = isSelected and Color3.fromRGB(110, 235, 145) or activeDef.textColor
		end
	end
end

local function applyTheme(themeName, instant)
	local def = THEMES[themeName]
	if not def then return end
	currentThemeName = themeName

	local tweenInfo = instant and TweenInfo.new(0) or TweenInfo.new(0.32, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

	for _, item in ipairs(themeRegisteredItems) do
		local obj = item.obj
		local role = item.role
		if obj and obj.Parent then
			pcall(function()
				if role == "panelBg" then
					TweenService:Create(obj, tweenInfo, { BackgroundColor3 = def.panelBg }):Play()
				elseif role == "cardBg" then
					TweenService:Create(obj, tweenInfo, { BackgroundColor3 = def.cardBg }):Play()
				elseif role == "stroke" then
					TweenService:Create(obj, tweenInfo, { Color = def.strokeColor }):Play()
				elseif role == "title" then
					TweenService:Create(obj, tweenInfo, { TextColor3 = def.titleColor }):Play()
				elseif role == "subTitle" then
					TweenService:Create(obj, tweenInfo, { TextColor3 = def.subTitleColor }):Play()
				elseif role == "text" then
					TweenService:Create(obj, tweenInfo, { TextColor3 = def.textColor }):Play()
				elseif role == "note" then
					TweenService:Create(obj, tweenInfo, { TextColor3 = def.noteColor }):Play()
				end
			end)
		end
	end

	updateThemeButtonVisuals()
	updateLanguageButtonVisuals()
	spawnSeasonalEffects(def.effectType)
end

local function findRightArmJoint(char)
	if not char then return nil, nil end
	local r15Arm = char:FindFirstChild("RightUpperArm")
	if r15Arm then
		local motor = r15Arm:FindFirstChild("RightShoulder")
		if motor and motor:IsA("Motor6D") then
			return motor, "R15"
		end
	end
	local torso = char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
	if torso then
		local r6Motor = torso:FindFirstChild("Right Shoulder")
		if r6Motor and r6Motor:IsA("Motor6D") then
			return r6Motor, "R6"
		end
	end
	return nil, nil
end

-- Płynne animowanie minimalizowania panelu i powrotu do poprzedniego rozmiaru oraz pozycji
local slideToken = 0

local function applyMinimizeState(instant)
	if not mainPanel or not contentHolder or not minimizeBtn then return end
	slideToken = slideToken + 1
	local myToken = slideToken

	minimizeBtn.Text = isMinimized and "+" or "-"

	if isMinimized then
		savedMainSizeBeforeMin = UDim2.new(0, PANEL_WIDTH, 0, EXPANDED_HEIGHT)
		savedMainPosBeforeMin = mainPanel.Position
		local minSize = UDim2.new(0, PANEL_WIDTH, 0, MINIMIZED_HEIGHT)
		local minPos = UDim2.new(
			savedMainPosBeforeMin.X.Scale,
			savedMainPosBeforeMin.X.Offset,
			savedMainPosBeforeMin.Y.Scale,
			savedMainPosBeforeMin.Y.Offset + 4
		)

		if instant then
			contentHolder.Visible = false
			contentHolder.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, -156)
			mainPanel.Size = minSize
			mainPanel.Position = minPos
			return
		end

		local sizeTween = TweenService:Create(
			mainPanel,
			TweenInfo.new(0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut),
			{ Size = minSize, Position = minPos }
		)
		local contentTween = TweenService:Create(
			contentHolder,
			TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
			{ Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, -156) }
		)
		sizeTween:Play()
		contentTween:Play()
		contentTween.Completed:Connect(function()
			if slideToken == myToken and isMinimized and contentHolder then
				contentHolder.Visible = false
			end
		end)
	else
		local restoreSize = savedMainSizeBeforeMin or UDim2.new(0, PANEL_WIDTH, 0, EXPANDED_HEIGHT)
		local restorePos = savedMainPosBeforeMin or mainPanel.Position

		if instant then
			contentHolder.Visible = true
			contentHolder.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 36)
			mainPanel.Size = restoreSize
			mainPanel.Position = restorePos
			return
		end

		contentHolder.Visible = true
		contentHolder.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, -156)

		local sizeTween = TweenService:Create(
			mainPanel,
			TweenInfo.new(0.32, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
			{ Size = restoreSize, Position = restorePos }
		)
		local contentTween = TweenService:Create(
			contentHolder,
			TweenInfo.new(0.26, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
			{ Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 36) }
		)
		sizeTween:Play()
		contentTween:Play()
	end
end

-- Przejście: 1. menu lekko spada w dół i wolniej idzie w górę, a od dołu wyjeżdża 2. menu
local screenSwitchToken = 0

local function setScriptsScreen(openScripts, instant)
	if not mainPanel or not scriptsPanel then return end
	isScriptsScreenOpen = openScripts
	applyMuffledMusicEffect(openScripts)

	screenSwitchToken = screenSwitchToken + 1
	local myToken = screenSwitchToken

	local mainCenterPos = savedMainPosBeforeMin or UDim2.new(0.5, -PANEL_WIDTH / 2, 0.3, -EXPANDED_HEIGHT / 2)
	local mainDipDownPos = UDim2.new(
		mainCenterPos.X.Scale,
		mainCenterPos.X.Offset,
		mainCenterPos.Y.Scale,
		mainCenterPos.Y.Offset + 22
	)
	local mainOffTopPos = UDim2.new(0.5, -PANEL_WIDTH / 2, 0, -EXPANDED_HEIGHT - 60)

	local scriptsCenterPos = UDim2.new(0.5, -SCRIPTS_WIDTH / 2, 0.5, -SCRIPTS_HEIGHT / 2)
	local scriptsOffBottomPos = UDim2.new(0.5, -SCRIPTS_WIDTH / 2, 1, 60)

	if instant then
		if openScripts then
			mainPanel.Visible = false
			mainPanel.Position = mainOffTopPos
			scriptsPanel.Visible = true
			scriptsPanel.Position = scriptsCenterPos
		else
			scriptsPanel.Visible = false
			scriptsPanel.Position = scriptsOffBottomPos
			mainPanel.Visible = true
			mainPanel.Position = mainCenterPos
		end
		return
	end

	if openScripts then
		scriptsPanel.Visible = true
		scriptsPanel.Position = scriptsOffBottomPos
		mainPanel.Visible = true

		local inTween = TweenService:Create(
			scriptsPanel,
			TweenInfo.new(0.74, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
			{ Position = scriptsCenterPos }
		)
		inTween:Play()

		task.spawn(function()
			local dipTween = TweenService:Create(
				mainPanel,
				TweenInfo.new(0.20, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
				{ Position = mainDipDownPos }
			)
			dipTween:Play()
			dipTween.Completed:Wait()
			if screenSwitchToken ~= myToken or not isScriptsScreenOpen or not mainPanel then return end

			local riseTween = TweenService:Create(
				mainPanel,
				TweenInfo.new(0.56, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut),
				{ Position = mainOffTopPos }
			)
			riseTween:Play()
			riseTween.Completed:Connect(function()
				if screenSwitchToken == myToken and isScriptsScreenOpen and mainPanel then
					mainPanel.Visible = false
				end
			end)
		end)
	else
		mainPanel.Visible = true
		mainPanel.Position = mainOffTopPos
		scriptsPanel.Visible = true

		local outTween = TweenService:Create(
			scriptsPanel,
			TweenInfo.new(0.54, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut),
			{ Position = scriptsOffBottomPos }
		)
		local inTween = TweenService:Create(
			mainPanel,
			TweenInfo.new(0.64, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
			{ Position = mainCenterPos }
		)

		outTween:Play()
		inTween:Play()

		outTween.Completed:Connect(function()
			if screenSwitchToken == myToken and (not isScriptsScreenOpen) and scriptsPanel then
				scriptsPanel.Visible = false
			end
		end)
	end
end

RunService.Stepped:Connect(function(_, dt)
	local char = player.Character
	if not char then return end

	if noclipActive then
		for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				part.CanCollide = false
			end
		end
	end

	local joint, rigType = findRightArmJoint(char)
	if joint then
		if not savedRightShoulderC0 then
			savedRightShoulderC0 = joint.C0
		end

		local targetBlend = heroPoseActive and 1 or 0
		local step = math.clamp((dt or 0.016) * 10, 0, 1)
		currentArmBlend = currentArmBlend + (targetBlend - currentArmBlend) * step

		if currentArmBlend > 0.002 then
			local raisedOffset = (rigType == "R6")
				and CFrame.Angles(math.rad(175), 0, 0)
				or CFrame.Angles(math.rad(165), 0, math.rad(-10))
			local targetC0 = savedRightShoulderC0 * raisedOffset
			joint.C0 = savedRightShoulderC0:Lerp(targetC0, currentArmBlend)
		elseif not heroPoseActive and currentArmBlend <= 0.002 then
			currentArmBlend = 0
			joint.C0 = savedRightShoulderC0
		end
	end
end)

local function toggleFly()

local function toggleNoclip()

		if char then
			for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do

					part.CanCollide = true
				end
			end
		end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
	pcall(function()
		if not flying then return end
		
		local char = player.Character
		if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or not char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then 
			if flying then toggleFly() end
			return 
		end

		local root = char.HumanoidRootPart
		local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		humanoid.PlatformStand = true

		local moveVector = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
		if controlModule then
			moveVector = controlModule:GetMoveVector()
		else
			moveVector = humanoid.MoveDirection
		end

		local activeCam = workspace.CurrentCamera or camera
		local camCFrame = activeCam.CFrame
		local camLook = camCFrame.LookVector
		local camRight = camCFrame.RightVector

		local targetVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)

		if moveVector.Magnitude > 0.01 then
			targetVelocity = (camLook * (-moveVector.Z) + camRight * moveVector.X) * flySpeed
		end

		if bodyVelocity and bodyVelocity.Parent then
			bodyVelocity.Velocity = targetVelocity
		end

		if bodyGyro and bodyGyro.Parent then
			bodyGyro.CFrame = camCFrame
		end

		if flyCamShakeActive and activeCam then
			local speedRatio = math.clamp(targetVelocity.Magnitude / math.max(flySpeed, 1), 0.25, 1.5)
			local t = tick() * (14 + (flySpeed * 0.05))
			local amp = 0.045 * speedRatio
			local shakeOffset = Vector3.new(
				math.sin(t * 1.13) * amp,
				math.cos(t * 1.47) * amp,
				math.sin(t * 0.89) * (amp * 0.5)
			)
			local shakeTilt = CFrame.Angles(
				math.rad(math.sin(t * 1.3) * 0.22 * speedRatio),
				math.rad(math.cos(t * 0.95) * 0.22 * speedRatio),
				math.rad(math.sin(t * 1.65) * 0.35 * speedRatio)
			)
			activeCam.CFrame = camCFrame * CFrame.new(shakeOffset) * shakeTilt
		end
	end)
end)

local function getCharacter() return LocalPlayer.Character or LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait() end
local function getHumanoid() local c = getCharacter() return c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") end
local function getRoot() local c = getCharacter() return c and (c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or c:FindFirstChild("Torso")) end
local function findPlayer(name)
    if not name or name == "" then return nil end
    name = name:lower()
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer and (p.Name:lower():sub(1, #name) == name or p.DisplayName:lower():sub(1, #name) == name) then
            return p
        end
    end
    return nil
end

-- ==============================================================================
-- // 8. KOMUTLAR & MOBİL UYUMLU AKILLI UÇUŞ
-- ==============================================================================
local Commands = {}
local States = { Noclip = false, Flying = false, InfJump = false, ClickTp = false }
local flySpeed = 50
local flyBV, flyBG
local spinBV
local antiFlingActive = false

-- [KUSURSUZ MOBİL & PC UYUMLU SMART FLY]
Commands["fly"] = function(args)
    if States.Flying then return end
    States.Flying = true
    flySpeed = tonumber(args[1]) or 50

    local root = getRoot()
    local hum = getHumanoid()
    if not root or not hum then return end

    hum.PlatformStand = true

    flyBV = Instance.new("BodyVelocity", root)
    flyBV.Velocity = Vector3.zero
    flyBV.MaxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)

    flyBG = Instance.new("BodyGyro", root)
    flyBG.CFrame = root.CFrame
    flyBG.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
    flyBG.P = 9e4

    task.spawn(function()
        while States.Flying and root and hum and flyBV and flyBG do
            local moveDir = Vector3.zero

            if hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
                local flatLook = Vector3.new(Camera.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, Camera.CFrame.LookVector.Z).Unit
                local flatRight = Vector3.new(Camera.CFrame.RightVector.X, 0, Camera.CFrame.RightVector.Z).Unit

                local forwardAmount = hum.MoveDirection:Dot(flatLook)
                local rightAmount = hum.MoveDirection:Dot(flatRight)

                moveDir = (Camera.CFrame.LookVector * forwardAmount) + (Camera.CFrame.RightVector * rightAmount)
                if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then
                    moveDir = moveDir.Unit
                end
            end

            flyBV.Velocity = moveDir * flySpeed
            flyBG.CFrame = Camera.CFrame
            task.wait()
        end
    end)
end

Commands["unfly"] = function()
    States.Flying = false
    local hum = getHumanoid()
    if hum then hum.PlatformStand = false end
    if flyBV then flyBV:Destroy() end
    if flyBG then flyBG:Destroy() end
end

-- [TEMEL HAREKET]
Commands["speed"] = function(args) local h = getHumanoid() if h then h.WalkSpeed = tonumber(args[1]) or 16 end end
Commands["jump"] = function(args) local h = getHumanoid() if h then h.UseJumpPower = true h.JumpPower = tonumber(args[1]) or 50 end end
Commands["noclip"] = function() States.Noclip = true end
Commands["clip"] = function() States.Noclip = false end
Commands["infjump"] = function() States.InfJump = not States.InfJump end
Commands["clicktp"] = function() States.ClickTp = not States.ClickTp end

-- [TROLL & COMBAT]
Commands["fling"] = function(args)
    local target = findPlayer(args[1] or "")
    local root = getRoot()
    if not target or not target.Character or not root then return end
    local tRoot = target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or target.Character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
    if not tRoot then return end

    local bav = Instance.new("BodyAngularVelocity", root)
    bav.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    bav.AngularVelocity = Vector3.new(99999, 99999, 99999)

    local flingActive = true
    task.spawn(function()
        local t0 = tick()
        while flingActive and (tick() - t0 < 2.5) and tRoot and root do
            root.CFrame = tRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(math.random(-1, 1), 0, math.random(-1, 1))
            task.wait()
        end
        bav:Destroy()
    end)
end

Commands["antifling"] = function()
    antiFlingActive = not antiFlingActive
    if antiFlingActive then
        RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
            if antiFlingActive then
                for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                    if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character then
                        for _, part in ipairs(p.Character:GetDescendants()) do
                            if part:IsA("BasePart") then part.CanCollide = false end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end
end

Commands["invis"] = function()
    local char = getCharacter()
    if not char then return end
    for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") or part:IsA("Decal") then part.Transparency = 1 end
    end
end

Commands["vis"] = function()
    local char = getCharacter()
    if not char then return end
    for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
            part.Transparency = 0

    if not root then return end
    local spd = tonumber(args[1]) or 30
    if spinBV then spinBV:Destroy() end

    spinBV.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(0, math.huge, 0)
    spinBV.AngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, spd, 0)

end

            local hl = Instance.new("Highlight", p.Character)

            hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

    end

    for i = 1, 4 do

        t.Parent = LocalPlayer.Backpack
    end

Commands["tp"] = function(args)
    local target = findPlayer(args[1])
    local root = getRoot()
    if target and target.Character and root then
        local tRoot = target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or target.Character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
        if tRoot then root.CFrame = tRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 3) end
    end

end

Commands["shop"] = function()
    local placeId = game.PlaceId
    local serversUrl = "https://games.roblox.com/v1/games/" .. placeId .. "/servers/Public?sortOrder=Asc&limit=100"
    local success, result = pcall(function()
        return HttpService:JSONDecode(game:HttpGet(serversUrl))
    end)
    if success and result and result.data then
        for _, s in ipairs(result.data) do
            if s.playing < s.maxPlayers and s.id ~= game.JobId then
                TeleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(placeId, s.id, LocalPlayer)
                break
            end
        end
    end
end

local function executeText(text)
    if not text or text == "" then return end
    if text:sub(1, #Prefix) == Prefix then text = text:sub(#Prefix + 1) end

    local args = {}
    for word in text:gmatch("%S+") do table.insert(args, word) end

    local cmd = table.remove(args, 1)
    if cmd and Commands[cmd:lower()] then
        pcall(function() Commands[cmd:lower()](args) end)
    end
end

SendBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    executeText(CmdBox.Text)
    CmdBox.Text = ""
    toggleBar(false)
end)

CmdBox.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed)
    if enterPressed then
        executeText(CmdBox.Text)
        CmdBox.Text = ""
        toggleBar(false)
    end
end)

RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
    if States.Noclip then
        local c = LocalPlayer.Character
        if c then
            for _, p in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
                if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.CanCollide then p.CanCollide = false end
            end
        end
    end
end)

UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
    if States.InfJump then
        local h = getHumanoid()
        if h then h:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping) end
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
    if processed or not States.ClickTp then return end
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then
        local m = LocalPlayer:GetMouse()
        local r = getRoot()
        if r and m.Hit then r.CFrame = CFrame.new(m.Hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)) end
    end
end)

if TextChatService.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
    TextChatService.MessageReceived:Connect(function(msg)
        if msg.TextSource and msg.TextSource.UserId == LocalPlayer.UserId then
            executeText(msg.Text)
        end
    end)
else
    LocalPlayer.Chatted:Connect(function(msg) executeText(msg) end)
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local function fling()
    while running do
        RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()

        local character = player.Character
        local hrp = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        if hrp then
            local vel = hrp.Velocity

            hrp.Velocity =
                vel * 10000 + Vector3.new(0, 10000, 0)

            RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
            hrp.Velocity = vel

            RunService.Stepped:Wait()
            hrp.Velocity = vel + Vector3.new(0, movel, 0)

            movel = -movel
        end
    end
end

task.spawn(fling)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local MOVE_ANIMATION_ID = "rbxassetid://252557606"
local TOUCH_ANIMATION_ID = "rbxassetid://54584713"
local TOUCH_SOUND_ID = "rbxassetid://566593606"

local character
local humanoid
local animator

local moveTrack
local touchTrack
local touchSound

local touchCooldown = false
local touchToken = 0

local function setupCharacter(char)

    character = char
    humanoid = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

    if humanoid.RigType ~= Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 then
        warn("R6 ONLY!")
        return
    end

    animator = humanoid:WaitForChild("Animator")
    humanoid.WalkSpeed = 30

    local moveAnim = Instance.new("Animation")
    moveAnim.AnimationId = MOVE_ANIMATION_ID

    moveTrack = animator:LoadAnimation(moveAnim)
    moveTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
    moveTrack.Looped = true

    local touchAnim = Instance.new("Animation")
    touchAnim.AnimationId = TOUCH_ANIMATION_ID

    touchTrack = animator:LoadAnimation(touchAnim)
    touchTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action2
    touchTrack.Looped = false

    touchSound = Instance.new("Sound")
    touchSound.SoundId = TOUCH_SOUND_ID
    touchSound.Volume = 1
    touchSound.Parent = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    touchCooldown = false
    touchToken = 0

    local function checkTouch(otherPart)

        if not otherPart then return end

        local otherCharacter =
            otherPart:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")

        if not otherCharacter or otherCharacter == character then
            return
        end

        local otherHumanoid =
            otherCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

        if not otherHumanoid then return end

        if not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(otherCharacter) then
            return
        end

        if touchCooldown then return end

        touchCooldown = true
        touchToken += 1

        local currentToken = touchToken

        touchTrack:Play(0.05)

        touchSound:Stop()
        touchSound.TimePosition = 0
        touchSound:Play()

        task.delay(0.5, function()
            if currentToken ~= touchToken then return end

            if touchTrack and touchTrack.IsPlaying then
                touchTrack:Stop(0.05)
            end
        end)

        task.delay(0.5, function()
            if currentToken == touchToken then
                touchCooldown = false
            end
        end)
    end

    for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
            part.Touched:Connect(checkTouch)
        end
    end

    char.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(part)
        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
            part.Touched:Connect(checkTouch)
        end
    end)
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(setupCharacter)

if player.Character then
    task.spawn(setupCharacter, player.Character)
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()

    if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
        return
    end

    humanoid.WalkSpeed = 30

    if not moveTrack or not touchTrack then
        return
    end

    if humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.05 then
        if not moveTrack.IsPlaying then
            moveTrack:Play(0.1)
        end
    else
        if moveTrack.IsPlaying then
            moveTrack:Stop(0.1)
        end
    end
end)

-- Services

-- Drag (PC + Mobile)
do
    local dragging = false
    local dragStart, startPos

    mainFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPos = mainFrame.Position
            input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                    dragging = false
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    mainFrame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if not dragging then return end
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            local delta = input.Position - dragStart
            mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
                startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
                startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
            )
        end

end

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- CONFIG
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local BATCH_SIZE = 30                -- số ô chạm song song mỗi vòng
local TOTAL_MINES_DEFAULT = 100      -- tổng số mìn của bàn
local LAST_TILE_DEDUCTION = true     -- tự suy ra các ô còn lại khi đã biết hết phần còn lại (dựa trên tổng số mìn)
local GLOBAL_MINES_ENABLED = true    -- dùng ràng buộc "tổng số mìn" (tự tắt nếu dữ liệu mâu thuẫn)
local MINE_MARKER_THRESHOLD = 90     -- đủ số mìn này thì dựng tia "Here"
local AUTO_TOUCH_RANGE = 60
local ANTI_LAG_DISTANCE = 60
local SOLVER_CONTEXT_PADDING = 8
local FLAG_REFRESH_INTERVAL = 0.5
local VISUALS_IN_WORKSPACE = true
local VISUAL_HARD_RANGE = 250        -- khi Anti-Lag OFF vẫn không vẽ highlight xa hơn mức này (giảm lag mobile)
local LOOP_INTERVAL = 0.12
local FORCE_SOLVE_INTERVAL = 2       -- ép giải lại tối thiểu mỗi 2s dù trạng thái không đổi
local MAX_COMPONENT_CELLS = 26       -- cụm biên lớn hơn mức này dùng suy luận tập hợp thay vì liệt kê
local MAX_ENUM_NODES = 40000         -- trần số nút backtracking mỗi cụm
local BULK_CHANGE_THRESHOLD = 150    -- số part thêm/xoá cùng lúc coi là "ván mới"
local FLAG_CELL = 6                  -- kích thước ô lưới băm vị trí cờ

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- STATE
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local isScanning = false
local isAutoTouching = false
local isAntiLagOn = false

local solverGeneration = 0
local autoTouchGeneration = 0

local cachedParts = {}
local cachedSet = {}
local neighborMap = {}
local numberTiles = {}
local knownMines = {}
local knownSafe = {}
local probabilityMap = {}
local currentBestGuess = nil
local connections = {}
local trackedVisuals = {}
local checkedNoNumber = {}     -- [part] = {n = lần thử, t = thời điểm thử gần nhất}
local flagGrid = {}
local lastUnknown = {}
local lastSig = nil
local lastSolveTime = 0
local lastSoftReset = 0
local conflicts = 0

local actionCooldown = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

local addedQueue = {}
local removedSinceFlush = 0
local flushScheduled = false

local herePillarPart = nil
local hereBillboardGui = nil
local hereTargetPart = nil
local hereHeight = 8
local hereRenderConn = nil

local fiftyFiftyAlertActive = false
local activeAlertLabel = nil
local activeAlertTween = nil
local alertToken = 0

local visualsFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
visualsFolder.Name = "TopEspVisuals_" .. tostring(screenGui.Name)
if VISUALS_IN_WORKSPACE then
    pcall(function() visualsFolder.Parent = Workspace end)
end
if not visualsFolder.Parent then
    visualsFolder.Parent = guiParent
end

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 50/50 NOTIFICATION
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function clearFiftyFiftyAlert()
    alertToken = alertToken + 1
    fiftyFiftyAlertActive = false
    if activeAlertTween then
        pcall(function() activeAlertTween:Cancel() end)
        activeAlertTween = nil
    end
    if activeAlertLabel then
        pcall(function() activeAlertLabel:Destroy() end)
        activeAlertLabel = nil
    end
end

local function triggerFiftyFiftyAlert()
    if fiftyFiftyAlertActive then return end
    fiftyFiftyAlertActive = true
    alertToken = alertToken + 1
    local currentToken = alertToken

    local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    lbl.Name = "FiftyFiftyAlert"
    lbl.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.75, 0)
    lbl.Size = UDim2.new(0, 420, 0, 22)
    lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    lbl.Text = "Open other boxes to reduce the chances of having to guess."
    lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    lbl.TextSize = 14
    lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    lbl.TextWrapped = false
    lbl.TextScaled = false
    lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    lbl.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
    lbl.Parent = screenGui
    activeAlertLabel = lbl

    task.delay(3, function()
        if currentToken ~= alertToken or not lbl or not lbl.Parent then return end
        local tween = TweenService:Create(lbl,
            TweenInfo.new(0.85, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
            { Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1.08, 0), TextTransparency = 1 })
        activeAlertTween = tween
        tween.Completed:Connect(function()
            if currentToken == alertToken then
                if activeAlertLabel == lbl then activeAlertLabel = nil end
                activeAlertTween = nil
                fiftyFiftyAlertActive = false
                pcall(function() lbl:Destroy() end)
            end
        end)
        tween:Play()
    end)
end

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- HELPERS
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function getTileRoot()
    local flagObj = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Flag")
    if not flagObj then return nil end
    return flagObj:FindFirstChild("Parts")
end

local function getCharPos()
    local char = player.Character
    local root = char and (char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChild("Head"))
    return root and root.Position or nil
end

local function isWithinDistance(part, charPos, maxDist)
    if not charPos or not part then return true end
    return (part.Position - charPos).Magnitude <= maxDist
end

local function isWithinActiveRange(part, charPos, extraPadding)
    if not isAntiLagOn then return true end
    if not charPos or not part then return true end
    return (part.Position - charPos).Magnitude <= ANTI_LAG_DISTANCE + (extraPadding or 0)
end

local function sortByProximity(list, charPos)
    if not charPos or #list <= 1 then return end
    table.sort(list, function(a, b)
        return (a.Position - charPos).Magnitude < (b.Position - charPos).Magnitude
    end)
end

local function countKnownMines()
    local count = 0
    for part, isMine in pairs(knownMines) do
        if isMine and part and part.Parent then
            count = count + 1
        end
    end
    return count
end

local function countKnownSafeUnrevealed()
    local count = 0
    for part, isSafe in pairs(knownSafe) do
        if isSafe and part and part.Parent then
            count = count + 1
        end
    end
    return count
end

local function isColorMatch(c1, r, g, b)
    return math.abs(c1.R - r) < 0.05 and math.abs(c1.G - g) < 0.05 and math.abs(c1.B - b) < 0.05
end

-- Ô rác: RGB(255,255,125)
local function isExcluded(part)
    if not part:IsA("BasePart") then return true end
    return isColorMatch(part.Color, 1.000, 1.000, 0.490)
end

-- Ô số: RGB(230,230,113)
local function isNumberColor(part)
    if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart") then return false end
    return isColorMatch(part.Color, 0.902, 0.902, 0.443)
end

-- Ô chưa mở: chỉ dựa trên màu (không phụ thuộc cache số) để phát hiện ván reset
local function isUnrevealed(part)
    if not part or not part.Parent or not part:IsA("BasePart") then return false end
    local c = part.Color
    if isColorMatch(c, 1.000, 1.000, 0.490) then return false end
    return isColorMatch(c, 0.804, 0.557, 0.392) or isColorMatch(c, 0.706, 0.490, 0.345)
end

-- FIX: bản gốc có thể lặp vô hạn ở đây (FindFirstChildWhichIsA không nhận tham số thứ 3)
local function getNumber(part)
    if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart") or isExcluded(part) then return nil end
    for _, d in ipairs(part:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("TextLabel") and d.Visible then
            local num = tonumber(string.match(d.Text, "%d+"))
            if num and num >= 1 and num <= 8 then return num end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function isTileCandidate(part)
    if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart") then return false end
    if isExcluded(part) then return false end
    if isNumberColor(part) or isUnrevealed(part) then return true end
    if part.Name == "Part" and part.Parent and string.find(string.lower(part.Parent.Name), "part") then
        return true
    end
    if part:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel", true) then
        return getNumber(part) ~= nil
    end
    return false
end

local function countUnrevealedNeighbors(part)
    local neighbors = neighborMap[part]
    if not neighbors then return 0 end
    local c = 0
    for _, n in ipairs(neighbors) do
        if isUnrevealed(n) and not knownMines[n] and not knownSafe[n] then c = c + 1 end
    end
    return c
end

local function countRevealedNumberNeighbors(part)
    local neighbors = neighborMap[part]
    if not neighbors then return 0 end
    local c = 0
    for _, n in ipairs(neighbors) do
        if n.Parent and numberTiles[n] then c = c + 1 end
    end
    return c
end

local function onCooldown(part, secs)
    local t = actionCooldown[part]
    return t ~= nil and (os.clock() - t) < secs
end

local function stamp(part)
    actionCooldown[part] = os.clock()
end

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- FLAG CACHE (lưới băm không gian -> hasFlag O(1))
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function addFlagPos(pos)
    local k = math.floor(pos.X / FLAG_CELL) .. ":" .. math.floor(pos.Z / FLAG_CELL)
    local b = flagGrid[k]
    if not b then b = {}; flagGrid[k] = b end
    b[#b + 1] = pos
end

local function refreshFlagCache()
    flagGrid = {}

    local flagFolder = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Flag") or Workspace:FindFirstChild("Flags")
    if flagFolder then
        for _, desc in ipairs(flagFolder:GetDescendants()) do
            if desc:IsA("BasePart") and not cachedSet[desc] then
                addFlagPos(desc.Position)
            end
        end
    end

    for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if obj:IsA("Model") and string.find(string.lower(obj.Name), "flag") then
            local primary = obj.PrimaryPart or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
            if primary then addFlagPos(primary.Position) end
        end
    end
end

local function hasFlag(part)
    if not part or not part.Parent then return false end
    local pPos = part.Position
    local sx = part.Size.X * 0.55
    local sz = part.Size.Z * 0.55
    local cx = math.floor(pPos.X / FLAG_CELL)
    local cz = math.floor(pPos.Z / FLAG_CELL)
    for ix = cx - 1, cx + 1 do
        for iz = cz - 1, cz + 1 do
            local b = flagGrid[ix .. ":" .. iz]
            if b then
                for _, f in ipairs(b) do
                    local dy = f.Y - pPos.Y
                    if math.abs(f.X - pPos.X) < sx and math.abs(f.Z - pPos.Z) < sz and dy > 0.3 and dy < 6 then
                        return true
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function clickTile(part)
    if not part or not part.Parent then return end
    local cd = part:FindFirstChildOfClass("ClickDetector") or part:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ClickDetector", true)
    if cd and typeof(fireclickdetector) == "function" then
        fireclickdetector(cd, 0)
    end
end

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- TOUCH TRIGGER
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function triggerTileTouch(targetTile)
    if not targetTile or not targetTile.Parent then return end
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return end

    local limb = char:FindFirstChild("RightFoot")
        or char:FindFirstChild("Right Leg")
        or char:FindFirstChild("LeftFoot")
        or char:FindFirstChild("Left Leg")
        or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not limb then return end

    if typeof(firetouchinterest) == "function" then
        firetouchinterest(limb, targetTile, 0)
        task.wait(0.015)
        firetouchinterest(limb, targetTile, 1)
    else
        local probe = Instance.new("Part")
        probe.Name = "LegProbe"
        probe.Size = limb.Size
        probe.CanCollide = false
        probe.CanQuery = false
        probe.CanTouch = true
        probe.Massless = true
        probe.Transparency = 1
        probe.CFrame = targetTile.CFrame
        probe.Parent = char
        task.wait(0.02)
        pcall(function() probe:Destroy() end)
    end
end

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- "HERE" 3D FLAT RAY + BILLBOARD (>= MINE_MARKER_THRESHOLD)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function stopHereFacingLoop()
    if hereRenderConn then
        hereRenderConn:Disconnect()
        hereRenderConn = nil
    end
end

local function applyHereFacingCFrame()
    if not herePillarPart or not herePillarPart.Parent or not hereTargetPart or not hereTargetPart.Parent then
        return
    end
    local baseTopY = hereTargetPart.Position.Y + (hereTargetPart.Size.Y * 0.5)
    local centerPos = Vector3.new(hereTargetPart.Position.X, baseTopY + (hereHeight * 0.5), hereTargetPart.Position.Z)

    local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    local lookTarget = cam and Vector3.new(cam.CFrame.Position.X, centerPos.Y, cam.CFrame.Position.Z)
    if lookTarget and (lookTarget - centerPos).Magnitude > 0.01 then
        herePillarPart.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(centerPos, lookTarget)
    else
        herePillarPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(centerPos)
    end
end

local function startHereFacingLoop()
    if hereRenderConn then return end
    hereRenderConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not isScanning or not herePillarPart or not herePillarPart.Parent then
            stopHereFacingLoop()
            return
        end
        applyHereFacingCFrame()
    end)
end

local function clearHerePillar()
    stopHereFacingLoop()
    hereTargetPart = nil
    if hereBillboardGui then
        pcall(function() hereBillboardGui:Destroy() end)
        hereBillboardGui = nil
    end
    if herePillarPart then
        pcall(function() herePillarPart:Destroy() end)
        herePillarPart = nil
    end
end

local function findNearestUnrevealedTile(charPos)
    local nearestPart, shortestDist = nil, math.huge
    for _, part in ipairs(lastUnknown) do
        if part.Parent and isUnrevealed(part)
            and not knownMines[part] and not knownSafe[part]
            and isWithinActiveRange(part, charPos, 0)
            and not hasFlag(part) then
            local dist = charPos and (part.Position - charPos).Magnitude or 0
            if dist < shortestDist then
                shortestDist = dist
                nearestPart = part
            end
        end
    end
    return nearestPart
end

local function updateHerePillar(charPos, foundMinesCount)
    if not isScanning or foundMinesCount < MINE_MARKER_THRESHOLD then
        clearHerePillar()
        return
    end

    local target = findNearestUnrevealedTile(charPos)
    if not target then
        clearHerePillar()
        return
    end
    hereTargetPart = target

    local flatWidth = math.max(0.45, math.min(target.Size.X, target.Size.Z) * 0.35)
    local flatThickness = 0.06

    if not herePillarPart or not herePillarPart.Parent then
        local p = Instance.new("Part")
        p.Name = "HereFlatRay"
        p.Anchored = true
        p.CanCollide = false
        p.CanTouch = false
        p.CanQuery = false
        p.CastShadow = false
        p.Massless = true
        p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
        p.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        p.Transparency = 0.25
        p.Size = Vector3.new(flatWidth, hereHeight, flatThickness)
        p.Parent = visualsFolder
        herePillarPart = p
    else
        herePillarPart.Size = Vector3.new(flatWidth, hereHeight, flatThickness)
    end

    applyHereFacingCFrame()
    startHereFacingLoop()

    if not hereBillboardGui or not hereBillboardGui.Parent then
        local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        bb.Name = "HereBillboard"
        bb.Adornee = herePillarPart
        bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
        bb.Size = UDim2.new(0, 76, 0, 26)
        bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, (hereHeight * 0.5) + 1.2, 0)
        bb.Parent = guiParent

        local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        lbl.Name = "HereLabel"
        lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        lbl.Text = "Here"
        lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        lbl.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        lbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.35
        lbl.TextScaled = true
        lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        lbl.Parent = bb
        hereBillboardGui = bb
    else
        hereBillboardGui.Adornee = herePillarPart
    end
end

local function clearVisuals(part)
    if not part then return end
    local entry = trackedVisuals[part]
    if entry then
        if entry.box then pcall(function() entry.box:Destroy() end) end
        if entry.topFill then pcall(function() entry.topFill:Destroy() end) end
        trackedVisuals[part] = nil
    end
end

local function clearAllVisuals()
    for part, entry in pairs(trackedVisuals) do
        if entry then
            if entry.box then pcall(function() entry.box:Destroy() end) end
            if entry.topFill then pcall(function() entry.topFill:Destroy() end) end
        end
        trackedVisuals[part] = nil
    end
end

local function withinVisualRange(part, charPos)
    if not charPos or not part then return true end
    local limit = isAntiLagOn and ANTI_LAG_DISTANCE or VISUAL_HARD_RANGE
    return (part.Position - charPos).Magnitude <= limit
end

local function createHighlight(part, color, name)
    if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart") or not part.Parent then return end

    local charPos = getCharPos()
    if not withinVisualRange(part, charPos) then
        clearVisuals(part)
        return
    end

    local existing = trackedVisuals[part]
    if name == "Guess_Highlight" and existing
        and (existing.tag == "Safe_Highlight" or existing.tag == "Mine_Highlight") then
        return
    end
    if existing and existing.tag == name and existing.topFill and existing.topFill.Parent then
        return
    end

    clearVisuals(part)

    local capThickness = 0.06
    local topFill = Instance.new("Part")
    topFill.Name = name .. "_TopCap"
    topFill.Anchored = true
    topFill.CanCollide = false
    topFill.CanTouch = false
    topFill.CanQuery = false
    topFill.CastShadow = false
    topFill.Massless = true
    topFill.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
    topFill.Color = color
    topFill.Transparency = 0.45
    topFill.Size = Vector3.new(
        math.max(0.1, part.Size.X * 0.96),
        capThickness,
        math.max(0.1, part.Size.Z * 0.96)
    )
    topFill.CFrame = part.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, (part.Size.Y * 0.5) + (capThickness * 0.5) + 0.02, 0)
    topFill.Parent = visualsFolder

    local box = Instance.new("SelectionBox")
    box.Name = name .. "_Border"
    box.Adornee = topFill
    box.Color3 = color
    box.LineThickness = 0.04
    box.Transparency = 0.05
    box.SurfaceTransparency = 1
    box.Parent = visualsFolder

    trackedVisuals[part] = { tag = name, box = box, topFill = topFill }
end

local function syncVisualsRange(charPos)
    for part, _ in pairs(trackedVisuals) do
        if not part.Parent or isExcluded(part) or numberTiles[part] or not isUnrevealed(part) then
            clearVisuals(part)
        elseif not withinVisualRange(part, charPos) then
            clearVisuals(part)
        end
    end

    for part, isMine in pairs(knownMines) do
        if isMine and part.Parent and isUnrevealed(part) and withinVisualRange(part, charPos) then
            createHighlight(part, Color3.new(1, 0, 0), "Mine_Highlight")
        end
    end

    for part, isSafe in pairs(knownSafe) do
        if isSafe and part.Parent and isUnrevealed(part) and withinVisualRange(part, charPos) then
            createHighlight(part, Color3.new(0, 1, 0), "Safe_Highlight")
        end
    end

    if currentBestGuess and currentBestGuess.Parent and isUnrevealed(currentBestGuess)
        and not knownMines[currentBestGuess] and not knownSafe[currentBestGuess]
        and withinVisualRange(currentBestGuess, charPos) then
        createHighlight(currentBestGuess, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0), "Guess_Highlight")
    end
end

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- NEIGHBOR CACHING
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function buildNeighborMapBulk(parts)
    local maxDim = 1
    for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
        local d = math.max(p.Size.X, p.Size.Z)
        if d > maxDim then maxDim = d end
    end
    local cellSize = math.max(4, maxDim * 2)

    local buckets = {}
    for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
        local key = math.floor(p.Position.X / cellSize) .. ":" .. math.floor(p.Position.Z / cellSize)
        local b = buckets[key]
        if not b then b = {}; buckets[key] = b end
        b[#b + 1] = p
    end

    for _, center in ipairs(parts) do
        local cx = math.floor(center.Position.X / cellSize)
        local cz = math.floor(center.Position.Z / cellSize)
        local radius = center.Size.X * 1.85
        local neighbors = {}
        for ix = cx - 1, cx + 1 do
            for iz = cz - 1, cz + 1 do
                local b = buckets[ix .. ":" .. iz]
                if b then
                    for _, p in ipairs(b) do
                        if p ~= center
                            and math.abs(p.Position.Y - center.Position.Y) < 1.5
                            and (p.Position - center.Position).Magnitude < radius then
                            neighbors[#neighbors + 1] = p
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        neighborMap[center] = neighbors
    end
end

local function cacheNeighbors(centerPart, forceRefresh)
    if not forceRefresh and neighborMap[centerPart] then return end

    local neighbors = {}
    local partsInBox = Workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(centerPart.CFrame, centerPart.Size * 2.5)
    for _, p in ipairs(partsInBox) do
        if p ~= centerPart and isTileCandidate(p) then
            if math.abs(p.Position.Y - centerPart.Position.Y) < 1.5
                and (p.Position - centerPart.Position).Magnitude < (centerPart.Size.X * 1.85) then
                neighbors[#neighbors + 1] = p
            end
        end
    end
    neighborMap[centerPart] = neighbors
end

local function rescanBoard()
    cachedParts = {}
    cachedSet = {}
    neighborMap = {}
    local tileRoot = getTileRoot()
    if not tileRoot then return end

    local candidates = {}
    for _, obj in ipairs(tileRoot:GetDescendants()) do
        if isTileCandidate(obj) then
            candidates[#candidates + 1] = obj
            cachedSet[obj] = true
        end
    end
    cachedParts = candidates
    buildNeighborMapBulk(candidates)
end
