local FileName = "VoidHubSavedScripts.json"
local SavedScripts = {}

if isfile and isfile(FileName) then
    local success, result = pcall(function() return readfile(FileName) end)
    if success and result then
        local decodeSuccess, decoded = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(result) end)
        if decodeSuccess and type(decoded) == "table" then SavedScripts = decoded end
    end
end

local function saveScriptsToFile()
    if writefile then pcall(function() writefile(FileName, HttpService:JSONEncode(SavedScripts)) end) end
end

local SettingsFileName = "VoidHubSettings.json"
local SavedBackgroundIndex = 1

if isfile and isfile(SettingsFileName) then
    local success, result = pcall(function() return readfile(SettingsFileName) end)
    if success and result then
        local decodeSuccess, decoded = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(result) end)
        if decodeSuccess and type(decoded) == "table" and type(decoded.BackgroundIndex) == "number" then
            SavedBackgroundIndex = decoded.BackgroundIndex
        end
    end
end

local function saveBackgroundIndex(idx)
    if writefile then pcall(function() writefile(SettingsFileName, HttpService:JSONEncode({BackgroundIndex = idx})) end) end
end

    if old then old:Destroy() end
end

if oldBlur then oldBlur:Destroy() end

end

emojiContainer.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
emojiContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
emojiContainer.Parent = ScreenGui

local emojis = {"✨", "🔥", "👾", "🚀", "💎", "🌟", "🎈", "🎵", "💫", "🪐"}
local emojiObjects = {}
local isFleeing = false

for i = 1, 20 do
    local emoji = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    emoji.Size = UDim2.new(0, math.random(30, 60), 0, math.random(30, 60))
    emoji.Position = UDim2.new(math.random(), 0, math.random(), 0)
    emoji.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    emoji.Text = emojis[math.random(1, #emojis)]
    emoji.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    emoji.TextScaled = true
    emoji.TextTransparency = math.random(40, 80) / 100
    emoji.Rotation = math.random(0, 360)
    emoji.Parent = emojiContainer
    
    local data = {
        Object = emoji,
        BasePos = emoji.Position,
        SpeedX = math.random(-10, 10) / 1000,
        SpeedY = math.random(-10, 10) / 1000,
        RotSpeed = math.random(-20, 20) / 10
    }
    table.insert(emojiObjects, data)
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
    if isFleeing then return end
    for _, data in pairs(emojiObjects) do
        local e = data.Object
        local x = e.Position.X.Scale + (data.SpeedX * dt)
        local y = e.Position.Y.Scale + (data.SpeedY * dt)
        
        if x < 0 then x = 1 elseif x > 1 then x = 0 end
        if y < 0 then y = 1 elseif y > 1 then y = 0 end
        
        e.Position = UDim2.new(x, 0, y, 0)
        e.Rotation = e.Rotation + (data.RotSpeed * dt * 10)
    end
end)

    container.BackgroundTransparency = 1

    label.Size = UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 1, 0)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    label.TextSize = 16
    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    label.Parent = container
    
    local switchBg = Instance.new("Frame")
    switchBg.Size = UDim2.new(0, 44, 0, 24)
    switchBg.Position = UDim2.new(1, -44, 0.5, -12)
    switchBg.BackgroundColor3 = default and Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 100) or Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
    switchBg.Parent = container
    Instance.new("UICorner", switchBg).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    
    local knob = Instance.new("Frame")
    knob.Size = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 20)
    knob.Position = default and UDim2.new(1, -22, 0.5, -10) or UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, -10)
    knob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    knob.Parent = switchBg
    Instance.new("UICorner", knob).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    btn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    btn.Text = ""
    btn.Parent = container
    
    local isOn = default
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        isOn = not isOn
        if isOn then
            TweenService:Create(switchBg, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 100)}):Play()
            TweenService:Create(knob, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {Position = UDim2.new(1, -22, 0.5, -10)}):Play()
        else
            TweenService:Create(switchBg, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)}):Play()
            TweenService:Create(knob, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {Position = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, -10)}):Play()
        end
        if callback then callback(isOn) end
    end)
end

local function createSlider(parent, text, min, max, default, yPos, callback)
    local container = Instance.new("Frame")
    container.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, 50)
    container.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0, yPos)
    container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    container.Parent = parent
    
    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Text = text .. ": " .. default
    label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 100)
    label.TextSize = 16
    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    label.Parent = container
    
    local sliderBg = Instance.new("Frame")
    sliderBg.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 8)
    sliderBg.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 30)
    sliderBg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 50)
    sliderBg.Parent = container
    Instance.new("UICorner", sliderBg).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1,0)
    
    local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
    fill.Size = UDim2.new((default-min)/(max-min), 0, 1, 0)
    fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 100)
    fill.Parent = sliderBg
    Instance.new("UICorner", fill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1,0)
    
    local knob = Instance.new("Frame")
    knob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    knob.Size = UDim2.new(0, 18, 0, 18)
    knob.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0)
    knob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    knob.Parent = fill
    Instance.new("UICorner", knob).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1,0)
    
    local dragging = false
    knob.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then dragging = true end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then dragging = false end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            local percent = math.clamp((input.Position.X - sliderBg.AbsolutePosition.X) / sliderBg.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
            fill.Size = UDim2.new(percent, 0, 1, 0)
            local val = math.floor(min + (percent * (max - min)))
            label.Text = text .. ": " .. val
            if callback then callback(val) end
        end
    end)
end

local function applySingleShader(preset)
    if activeEffects[preset.Name] then return end
    local cc = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
    cc.Name = "VoidShader_" .. preset.Name
    cc.Brightness = preset.Brightness
    cc.Contrast = preset.Contrast
    cc.Saturation = preset.Saturation
    cc.TintColor = preset.TintColor
    cc.Parent = Lighting
    activeEffects[preset.Name] = cc
end

local function removeSingleShader(name)
    if activeEffects[name] then
        activeEffects[name]:Destroy()
        activeEffects[name] = nil
    end
end

local function removeAllEffects()
    for name, effect in pairs(activeEffects) do
        effect:Destroy()
    end
    activeEffects = {}
end

    slider.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, yPos + 18)
    slider.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.SliderBg
    slider.BorderSizePixel = 0
    slider.ZIndex = 12
    slider.Parent = parent

    local sliderCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    sliderCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)
    sliderCorner.Parent = slider

    local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
    local startRelX = (startVal - minVal) / (maxVal - minVal)
    fill.Size = UDim2.new(startRelX, 0, 1, 0)
    fill.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent
    fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    fill.ZIndex = 13
    fill.Parent = slider
    local fillCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    fillCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)
    fillCorner.Parent = fill

    local knob = Instance.new("Frame")
    knob.Size = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 12)
    knob.Position = UDim2.new(startRelX, -6, 0.5, -6)
    knob.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Text
    knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
    knob.ZIndex = 14
    knob.Parent = slider
    local knobCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    knobCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    knobCorner.Parent = knob

    local isDragging = false
    local function update(inputPos)
        local relX = math.clamp((inputPos.X - slider.AbsolutePosition.X) / slider.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
        local value = minVal + (maxVal - minVal) * relX
        TweenService:Create(fill, TweenInfo.new(0.06), { Size = UDim2.new(relX, 0, 1, 0) }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(knob, TweenInfo.new(0.06), { Position = UDim2.new(relX, -6, 0.5, -6) }):Play()
        onUpdate(value)
    end
    slider.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            isDragging = true; update(input.Position)
        end
    end)
    slider.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then isDragging = false end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if isDragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then update(input.Position) end
    end)
    return lbl
end

local flyEnabled = false

local function startFly()
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return end
    local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)

    bv.Parent = hrp
    flyBodyVelocity = bv
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum then hum.PlatformStand = true end
    flyConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not flyBodyVelocity then return end
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local moveVec = Vector3.zero
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then moveVec += cam.CFrame.LookVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then moveVec -= cam.CFrame.LookVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then moveVec -= cam.CFrame.RightVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then moveVec += cam.CFrame.RightVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then moveVec += Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then moveVec -= Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
        if moveVec.Magnitude > 0 then moveVec = moveVec.Unit * currentFlySpeed end
        flyBodyVelocity.Velocity = moveVec
    end)
end

    if flyConnection then flyConnection:Disconnect(); flyConnection = nil end
    if flyBodyVelocity then flyBodyVelocity:Destroy(); flyBodyVelocity = nil end

-- ============================================================
-- FARM LOGIC (С СИСТЕМОЙ ПРОПУСКА И БЕЗ +5)
-- ============================================================
local farmOrbsActive = false
local farmXpActive = false

-- Черный список (запоминает объекты, к которым нельзя телепортироваться)
local skipList = {}

-- Очистка черного списка (если в нем больше 50 объектов или все орбы в нем)
local function clearSkipListIfNeeded()
    local count = 0
    for _ in pairs(skipList) do count = count + 1 end
    if count > 50 then
        skipList = {}
    end
end

-- Проверка, можно ли телепортироваться к объекту (он существует, он в Workspace, его не удалили)
local function isValidOrb(part)
    if not part or not part.Parent then return false end
    if skipList[part] then return false end
    return true
end

-- Поиск SandOrb / VoidOrb
local function findSandVoidOrb()
    clearSkipListIfNeeded()
    local orbs = {}
    
    local voidFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("VoidOrbs")
    if voidFolder then
        for _, obj in ipairs(voidFolder:GetChildren()) do
            local part = obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
            if part and isValidOrb(part) then table.insert(orbs, part) end
        end
    end
    
    local sandFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("SandOrbs")
    if sandFolder then
        for _, obj in ipairs(sandFolder:GetChildren()) do
            local part = obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
            if part and isValidOrb(part) then table.insert(orbs, part) end
        end
    end
    
    if #orbs > 0 then return orbs[1] end
    
    -- Если все орбы в черном списке, чистим его
    if #orbs == 0 and next(skipList) then
        skipList = {}
        return findSandVoidOrb()
    end
    
    return nil
end

-- Поиск Розового Orb (цвет 255, 110, 220)
local function findPinkOrb()
    clearSkipListIfNeeded()
    local orbs = {}
    local orbsFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Orbs")
    if orbsFolder then
        for _, obj in ipairs(orbsFolder:GetDescendants()) do
            if obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj.Name == "Orb" then
                local c = obj.Color
                if math.abs(c.R * 255 - 255) < 5 and math.abs(c.G * 255 - 110) < 5 and math.abs(c.B * 255 - 220) < 5 then
                    if isValidOrb(obj) then table.insert(orbs, obj) end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    if #orbs > 0 then return orbs[1] end
    
    if #orbs == 0 and next(skipList) then
        skipList = {}
        return findPinkOrb()
    end
    
    return nil
end

-- Универсальный телепорт (Y = 0, ровно в центр)
local function teleportTo(part)
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if hrp and part then
        hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(part.Position) -- Смещение 0, ровно в центр
        return true
    end
    return false
end

local espEnabled = false

local function startEsp()
    if espRunning then return end
    espRunning = true
    espThread = task.spawn(function()
        _G.FriendColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 255)
        _G.EnemyColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
        _G.UseTeamColor = true

        local Holder = Instance.new("Folder", game.CoreGui)

        NameTag.AlwaysOnTop = true

        Tag.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 20)
        Tag.TextSize = 15
        Tag.TextColor3 = Color3.new(100 / 255, 100 / 255, 100 / 255)
        Tag.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0 / 255, 0 / 255, 0 / 255)
        Tag.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
        Tag.Text = "nil"
        Tag.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
        Tag.TextScaled = false

        local LoadCharacter = function(v)
            repeat task.wait() until v.Character ~= nil
            v.Character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
            local vHolder = Holder:FindFirstChild(v.Name)
            if not vHolder then return end
            vHolder:ClearAllChildren()
            local b = Box:Clone()
            b.Name = v.Name .. "Box"
            b.Adornee = v.Character
            b.Parent = vHolder
            local t = NameTag:Clone()
            t.Name = v.Name .. "NameTag"
            t.Enabled = true
            t.Parent = vHolder
            t.Adornee = v.Character:WaitForChild("Head", 5)
            if not t.Adornee then
                return UnloadCharacter(v)
            end
            t.Tag.Text = v.Name
            b.Color3 = Color3.new(v.TeamColor.r, v.TeamColor.g, v.TeamColor.b)
            t.Tag.TextColor3 = Color3.new(v.TeamColor.r, v.TeamColor.g, v.TeamColor.b)
            local Update
            local UpdateNameTag = function()
                if not pcall(function()
                    v.Character.Humanoid.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
                end) then
                    if Update then Update:Disconnect() end
                end
            end
            UpdateNameTag()
            Update = v.Character.Humanoid.Changed:Connect(UpdateNameTag)
        end

        local UnloadCharacter = function(v)
            local vHolder = Holder:FindFirstChild(v.Name)
            if vHolder and (vHolder:FindFirstChild(v.Name .. "Box") ~= nil or vHolder:FindFirstChild(v.Name .. "NameTag") ~= nil) then
                vHolder:ClearAllChildren()
            end
        end

        local LoadPlayer = function(v)
            local vHolder = Instance.new("Folder", Holder)
            vHolder.Name = v.Name
            v.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
                pcall(LoadCharacter, v)
            end)
            v.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
                pcall(UnloadCharacter, v)
            end)
            v.Changed:Connect(function(prop)
                if prop == "TeamColor" then
                    UnloadCharacter(v)
                    task.wait()
                    LoadCharacter(v)
                end
            end)
            LoadCharacter(v)
        end

        local UnloadPlayer = function(v)
            UnloadCharacter(v)
            local vHolder = Holder:FindFirstChild(v.Name)
            if vHolder then
                vHolder:Destroy()
            end
        end

        for i,v in pairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
            task.spawn(function() pcall(LoadPlayer, v) end)
        end

        game:GetService("Players").PlayerAdded:Connect(function(v)
            pcall(LoadPlayer, v)
        end)

        game:GetService("Players").PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(v)
            pcall(UnloadPlayer, v)
        end)

        game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.NameDisplayDistance = 0

        if _G.Reantheajfdfjdgs then
            return
        end

        _G.Reantheajfdfjdgs = ":suifayhgvsdghfsfkajewfrhk321rk213kjrgkhj432rj34f67df"

        local players = game:GetService("Players")
        local plr = players.LocalPlayer

        function esp(target, color)
            if target.Character then
                if not target.Character:FindFirstChild("GetReal") then
                    local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
                    highlight.RobloxLocked = true
                    highlight.Name = "GetReal"
                    highlight.Adornee = target.Character
                    highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
                    highlight.FillColor = color
                    highlight.Parent = target.Character
                else
                    target.Character.GetReal.FillColor = color
                end
            end
        end

        while espRunning do
            task.wait(1)
            for i, v in pairs(players:GetPlayers()) do
                if v ~= plr then
                    esp(v, _G.UseTeamColor and v.TeamColor.Color or ((plr.TeamColor == v.TeamColor) and _G.FriendColor or _G.EnemyColor))
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

local function stopEsp()
    espRunning = false
    if espThread then
        task.cancel(espThread)
        espThread = nil
    end
    local espFolder = game.CoreGui:FindFirstChild("ESP")
    if espFolder then
        espFolder:Destroy()
    end
end

scripts.code:
-- [[ Rscripts Risk Notice ]]
-- This script is not verified by rscripts.net. Deal with caution.
--
-- Stay safe:
--   • Never log in on unofficial Roblox sites or lookalike domains.
--   • Real Roblox links use roblox.com (check the .com ending).
--   • Treat fake Roblox login / "claim reward" pages as phishing.
-- [[ End Rscripts Risk Notice ]]

-- Arsenal Hub v2 — draggable, scrollable, rounded UI
-- Executor requirements: Drawing API, loadstring, CoreGui access.

assert(Drawing, "Drawing API required")

local Players          = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService       = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Workspace        = game:GetService("Workspace")
local VirtualUser      = game:GetService("VirtualUser")
local CoreGui          = game:GetService("CoreGui")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera      = Workspace.CurrentCamera

-- ============================================================
-- CONFIG
-- ============================================================
local Config = {
    Aimbot = {
        Enabled    = false,
        Mode       = "Manual",        -- "Manual" | "Automatic"
        Key        = Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2,
        FOV        = 140,
        Smoothness = 0.45,
        TargetPart = "Head",
        WallCheck  = true,
        TeamCheck  = true,
    },
    AutoShoot = {
        Enabled = false,
        Mode    = "Automatic",
        Key     = Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1,
        Delay   = 0.08,
    },
    ESP = {
        Enabled     = true,
        ShowPlayers = true,
        ShowBots    = true,
        Box         = true,
        Name        = true,
        Distance    = true,
        Tracer      = false,
        Color       = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 120),
    },
}

-- ============================================================
-- HELPERS
-- ============================================================
local function isAlive(character)
    local hum = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    return hum ~= nil and hum.Health > 0
end

local function getHead(character)
    return character and character:FindFirstChild("Head")
end

local function getRoot(character)
    return character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function getTeam(entity)
    if entity:IsA("Player") then return entity.Team end
    return nil
end

local function isSameTeam(entity)
    if not Config.Aimbot.TeamCheck then return false end
    local myTeam, theirTeam = LocalPlayer.Team, getTeam(entity)
    return myTeam ~= nil and theirTeam ~= nil and myTeam == theirTeam
end

local function wallClear(fromPos, toPos)
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { LocalPlayer.Character }
    local result = Workspace:Raycast(fromPos, toPos - fromPos, params)
    if not result then return true end
    local model = result.Instance:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
    if model and (model == LocalPlayer.Character or model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")) then
        return true
    end
    return false
end

-- Bot cache (refreshed once per second)
local botCache = {}
local lastBotScan = 0
local function scanBots()
    botCache = {}
    for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("Model") and obj:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
            if not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(obj) then
                table.insert(botCache, obj)
            end
        end
    end
end

local function getEntities()
    local list = {}
    if Config.ESP.ShowPlayers then
        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character and isAlive(plr.Character) then
                table.insert(list, { entity = plr, character = plr.Character, isPlayer = true })
            end
        end
    end
    if Config.ESP.ShowBots then
        for _, bot in ipairs(botCache) do
            if isAlive(bot) then
                table.insert(list, { entity = bot, character = bot, isPlayer = false })
            end
        end
    end
    return list
end

local function findTarget()
    local best, bestDist = nil, math.huge
    local camPos = Camera.CFrame.Position
    local center = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X * 0.5, Camera.ViewportSize.Y * 0.5)

    for _, data in ipairs(getEntities()) do
        local char = data.character
        if not isSameTeam(data.entity) then
            local part = char:FindFirstChild(Config.Aimbot.TargetPart) or getHead(char)
            if part then
                local sp, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
                if onScreen and sp.Z > 0 then
                    local dist = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - center).Magnitude
                    if dist <= Config.Aimbot.FOV then
                        if not Config.Aimbot.WallCheck or wallClear(camPos, part.Position) then
                            if dist < bestDist then
                                bestDist = dist
                                best = { entity = data.entity, character = char, part = part }
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return best
end

-- ============================================================
-- UI SHELL
-- ============================================================
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "ArsenalHub"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
screenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
screenGui.Parent = CoreGui

local ACCENT   = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 120)
local BG_MAIN  = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 22)
local BG_HEAD  = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 34)
local BG_ITEM  = Color3.fromRGB(38, 38, 46)
local BG_HOVER = Color3.fromRGB(52, 52, 62)
local TXT_MAIN = Color3.fromRGB(225, 225, 230)
local TXT_DIM  = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 160)

local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
mainFrame.Name = "Main"
mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 280, 0, 420)
mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 60, 0, 60)
mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = BG_MAIN
mainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
mainFrame.Active = true
mainFrame.ClipsDescendants = true
mainFrame.Parent = screenGui
Instance.new("UICorner", mainFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
do
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", mainFrame)
    stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 65)
    stroke.Thickness = 1
end

-- Title bar
local titleBar = Instance.new("Frame")
titleBar.Name = "TitleBar"
titleBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34)
titleBar.BackgroundColor3 = BG_HEAD
titleBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
titleBar.Parent = mainFrame
do
    local c = Instance.new("UICorner", titleBar)
    c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
    local fix = Instance.new("Frame", titleBar)
    fix.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 12)
    fix.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -12)
    fix.BackgroundColor3 = BG_HEAD
    fix.BorderSizePixel = 0
    fix.ZIndex = 1
end

local accentBar = Instance.new("Frame")
accentBar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0, 16)
accentBar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.5, 0)
accentBar.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
accentBar.BackgroundColor3 = ACCENT
accentBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
accentBar.ZIndex = 2
accentBar.Parent = titleBar
Instance.new("UICorner", accentBar).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

local titleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
titleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -110, 1, 0)
titleLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 0)
titleLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
titleLabel.Text = "ARSENAL HUB"
titleLabel.TextColor3 = TXT_MAIN
titleLabel.TextSize = 13
titleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Code
titleLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
titleLabel.ZIndex = 2
titleLabel.Parent = titleBar

local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
closeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 22, 0, 22)
closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 6)
closeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(190, 55, 55)
closeBtn.AutoButtonColor = true
closeBtn.Text = "X"
closeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
closeBtn.TextSize = 12
closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.Code
closeBtn.ZIndex = 3
closeBtn.Parent = titleBar
Instance.new("UICorner", closeBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)

-- Reopen button
local openBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
openBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 84, 0, 30)
openBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 20)
openBtn.BackgroundColor3 = BG_HEAD
openBtn.Text = "OPEN HUB"
openBtn.TextColor3 = ACCENT
openBtn.TextSize = 12
openBtn.Font = Enum.Font.Code
openBtn.Visible = false
openBtn.Parent = screenGui
Instance.new("UICorner", openBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
do
    local s = Instance.new("UIStroke", openBtn)
    s.Color = ACCENT
    s.Thickness = 1
    s.Transparency = 0.5
end

-- Scrollable content
local content = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
content.Name = "Content"
content.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, -42)
content.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 38)
content.BackgroundTransparency = 1
content.BorderSizePixel = 0
content.ScrollBarThickness = 4
content.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(95, 95, 110)
content.ScrollBarImageTransparency = 0.2
content.ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y
content.ScrollingEnabled = true
content.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
content.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
content.ElasticBehavior = Enum.ElasticBehavior.Never
content.Parent = mainFrame
do
    local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding", content)
    pad.PaddingLeft   = UDim.new(0, 3)
    pad.PaddingRight  = UDim.new(0, 7)
    pad.PaddingTop    = UDim.new(0, 4)
    pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 10)
    local lay = Instance.new("UIListLayout", content)
    lay.Padding = UDim.new(0, 5)
    lay.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
end

-- ============================================================
-- DRAG (clamped to viewport, mouse + touch)
-- ============================================================
local FRAME_W, FRAME_H = 280, 420
local dragging, dragStart, startPos = false, nil, nil

local function beginDrag(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = mainFrame.Position
    end
end

titleBar.InputBegan:Connect(beginDrag)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if not dragging then return end
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        local vp = Camera.ViewportSize
        local nx = math.clamp(startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, 0, vp.X - FRAME_W)
        local ny = math.clamp(startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y, 0, vp.Y - FRAME_H)
        mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, nx, 0, ny)
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = false
    end
end)

closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    mainFrame.Visible = false
    openBtn.Visible = true
end)
openBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    mainFrame.Visible = true
    openBtn.Visible = false
end)

-- ============================================================
-- UI FACTORY
-- ============================================================
local function addSection(text)
    local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
    holder.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
    holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    holder.Parent = content

    local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    lbl.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
    lbl.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
    lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    lbl.Text = text
    lbl.TextColor3 = ACCENT
    lbl.TextSize = 11
    lbl.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    lbl.Parent = holder
end

local function addDivider()
    local line = Instance.new("Frame")
    line.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1)
    line.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 55)
    line.BorderSizePixel = 0
    line.Parent = content
end

local function addToggle(text, initial, callback)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = BG_ITEM
    btn.AutoButtonColor = false
    btn.Text = ""
    btn.Parent = content
    Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)

    local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -60, 1, 0)
    lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
    lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    lbl.Text = text
    lbl.TextColor3 = TXT_MAIN
    lbl.TextSize = 12
    lbl.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    lbl.Parent = btn

    local track = Instance.new("Frame")
    track.Size = UDim2.new(0, 34, 0, 16)
    track.Position = UDim2.new(1, -44, 0.5, 0)
    track.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
    track.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 65)
    track.BorderSizePixel = 0
    track.Parent = btn
    Instance.new("UICorner", track).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local knob = Instance.new("Frame")
    knob.Size = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 12)
    knob.Position = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, 0)
    knob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
    knob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 225)
    knob.Parent = track
    Instance.new("UICorner", knob).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local state = initial
    local function render()
        if state then
            track.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 110)
            knob.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0.5, 0)
        else
            track.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 65)
            knob.Position = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, 0)
        end
    end
    render()

    btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() btn.BackgroundColor3 = BG_HOVER end)
    btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() btn.BackgroundColor3 = BG_ITEM end)
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        state = not state
        render()
        callback(state)
    end)
    return btn
end

local function addButton(text, callback)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = BG_ITEM
    btn.AutoButtonColor = false
    btn.Text = text
    btn.TextColor3 = TXT_MAIN
    btn.TextSize = 12
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    btn.Parent = content
    Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)

    btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() btn.BackgroundColor3 = BG_HOVER end)
    btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() btn.BackgroundColor3 = BG_ITEM end)
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
    return btn
end

local function addSlider(text, min, max, initial, decimals, callback)
    local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
    holder.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
    holder.BackgroundColor3 = BG_ITEM
    holder.BorderSizePixel = 0
    holder.Parent = content
    Instance.new("UICorner", holder).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)

    local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 18)
    lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 3)
    lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    lbl.TextColor3 = TXT_MAIN
    lbl.TextSize = 12
    lbl.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    lbl.Parent = holder

    local barBg = Instance.new("Frame")
    barBg.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 5)
    barBg.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 1, -13)
    barBg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 30)
    barBg.BorderSizePixel = 0
    barBg.Parent = holder
    Instance.new("UICorner", barBg).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
    fill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
    fill.BackgroundColor3 = ACCENT
    fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    fill.Parent = barBg
    Instance.new("UICorner", fill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local hitbox = Instance.new("Frame")
    hitbox.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 16)
    hitbox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 1, -18)
    hitbox.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    hitbox.Parent = holder

    local function fmt(v)
        if decimals > 0 then
            return string.format("%." .. decimals .. "f", v)
        end
        return tostring(math.floor(v + 0.5))
    end

    local value = initial
    local function setValue(v)
        v = math.clamp(v, min, max)
        value = v
        local alpha = (v - min) / (max - min)
        fill.Size = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 1, 0)
        lbl.Text = text .. ": " .. fmt(v)
        callback(v)
    end
    setValue(initial)

    local sliding = false
    local function fromInput(input)
        local rel = (input.Position.X - barBg.AbsolutePosition.X) / barBg.AbsoluteSize.X
        setValue(min + (max - min) * math.clamp(rel, 0, 1))
    end

    hitbox.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            sliding = true
            fromInput(input)
        end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if sliding and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            fromInput(input)
        end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            sliding = false
        end
    end)

    return holder
end

-- ============================================================
-- UI BUILD
-- ============================================================
addSection("TARGETING")

addToggle("Aimbot", Config.Aimbot.Enabled, function(v) Config.Aimbot.Enabled = v end)

addSlider("FOV", 10, 400, Config.Aimbot.FOV, 0, function(v) Config.Aimbot.FOV = v end)
addSlider("Smoothness", 0.05, 1.00, Config.Aimbot.Smoothness, 2, function(v) Config.Aimbot.Smoothness = v end)

local aimModeBtn
aimModeBtn = addButton("Aimbot Mode: " .. Config.Aimbot.Mode, function()
    Config.Aimbot.Mode = (Config.Aimbot.Mode == "Manual") and "Automatic" or "Manual"
    aimModeBtn.Text = "Aimbot Mode: " .. Config.Aimbot.Mode
end)

addToggle("Wall Check", Config.Aimbot.WallCheck, function(v) Config.Aimbot.WallCheck = v end)
addToggle("Team Check", Config.Aimbot.TeamCheck, function(v) Config.Aimbot.TeamCheck = v end)

addDivider()
addSection("AUTO FIRE")

addToggle("Auto Shoot", Config.AutoShoot.Enabled, function(v) Config.AutoShoot.Enabled = v end)
addSlider("Delay", 0.02, 0.50, Config.AutoShoot.Delay, 2, function(v) Config.AutoShoot.Delay = v end)

local shootModeBtn
shootModeBtn = addButton("Auto Shoot Mode: " .. Config.AutoShoot.Mode, function()

    if fovCircle then pcall(function() fovCircle:Remove() end) end
end)

-- ============================================================
-- ESP
-- ============================================================
local espObjects = {}

local function createESP(entity)
    if espObjects[entity] then return end
    local box = Drawing.new("Square")
    box.Thickness = 1.5
    box.Filled = false

    local nameText = Drawing.new("Text")
    nameText.Size = 13
    nameText.Center = true
    nameText.Outline = true

    local distText = Drawing.new("Text")
    distText.Size = 12
    distText.Center = true
    distText.Outline = true

    local tracer = Drawing.new("Line")
    tracer.Thickness = 1

    espObjects[entity] = { box = box, nameText = nameText, distText = distText, tracer = tracer }
end

local function removeESP(entity)
    local obj = espObjects[entity]
    if not obj then return end
    obj.box:Remove()
    obj.nameText:Remove()
    obj.distText:Remove()
    obj.tracer:Remove()
    espObjects[entity] = nil
end

local function updateESP()
    if not Config.ESP.Enabled then
        for _, obj in pairs(espObjects) do
            obj.box.Visible = false
            obj.nameText.Visible = false
            obj.distText.Visible = false
            obj.tracer.Visible = false
        end
        return
    end

    local active = {}
    for _, data in ipairs(getEntities()) do
        local entity, char = data.entity, data.character
        active[entity] = true
        if not espObjects[entity] then createESP(entity) end
        local esp = espObjects[entity]

        local head = getHead(char)
        local root = getRoot(char)
        local hidden = isSameTeam(entity) or not head or not root
        if not hidden then
            local headPos, headOn = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)
            local rootPos, rootOn = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position)
            if not headOn or not rootOn or headPos.Z < 0 then hidden = true end
            if not hidden then
                local height = math.abs(headPos.Y - rootPos.Y) * 1.35
                local width  = height * 0.55
                local topX   = headPos.X - width * 0.5
                local topY   = headPos.Y - height * 0.15

                esp.box.Position = Vector2.new(topX, topY)
                esp.box.Size = Vector2.new(width, height)
                esp.box.Color = Config.ESP.Color
                esp.box.Visible = Config.ESP.Box

                local dist = math.floor((Camera.CFrame.Position - head.Position).Magnitude)
                local display = data.isPlayer and entity.Name or (entity.Name .. " [BOT]")

                esp.nameText.Text = display
                esp.nameText.Position = Vector2.new(headPos.X, topY - 16)
                esp.nameText.Color = Config.ESP.Color
                esp.nameText.Visible = Config.ESP.Name

                esp.distText.Text = tostring(dist) .. "m"
                esp.distText.Position = Vector2.new(headPos.X, topY + height + 2)
                esp.distText.Color = Config.ESP.Color
                esp.distText.Visible = Config.ESP.Distance

                if Config.ESP.Tracer then
                    esp.tracer.From = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X * 0.5, Camera.ViewportSize.Y)
                    esp.tracer.To = Vector2.new(headPos.X, headPos.Y)
                    esp.tracer.Color = Config.ESP.Color
                    esp.tracer.Visible = true
                else
                    esp.tracer.Visible = false
                end
            end
        end
        if hidden then
            esp.box.Visible = false
            esp.nameText.Visible = false
            esp.distText.Visible = false
            esp.tracer.Visible = false
        end
    end

    for entity in pairs(espObjects) do
        if not active[entity] then removeESP(entity) end
    end
end

local fovCircle = Drawing.new("Circle")
fovCircle.Thickness = 1
fovCircle.Filled = false
fovCircle.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
fovCircle.Visible = false

-- ============================================================
-- AIMBOT / AUTO SHOOT
-- ============================================================
local lastShoot = 0

local function isHeld(key)
    if key.EnumType == Enum.UserInputType then
        return UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(key)
    end
    return UserInputService:IsKeyDown(key)
end

local function shouldAim()
    if not Config.Aimbot.Enabled then return false end
    if Config.Aimbot.Mode == "Automatic" then return true end
    return isHeld(Config.Aimbot.Key)
end

local function shouldShoot()
    if not Config.AutoShoot.Enabled then return false end
    if Config.AutoShoot.Mode == "Automatic" then return true end
    return isHeld(Config.AutoShoot.Key)
end

local function fireWeapon()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    local tool = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
    if tool then pcall(function() tool:Activate() end) end
    pcall(function()
        if VirtualUser then VirtualUser:ClickButton1(Vector2.new()) end
    end)
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    local now = tick()
    if now - lastBotScan > 1 then
        lastBotScan = now
        scanBots()
    end

    if Config.Aimbot.Enabled then
        fovCircle.Radius = Config.Aimbot.FOV
        fovCircle.Position = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X * 0.5, Camera.ViewportSize.Y * 0.5)
        fovCircle.Visible = true
    else
        fovCircle.Visible = false
    end

    updateESP()

    local target = findTarget()
    if target then
        if shouldAim() then
            local desired = CFrame.new(Camera.CFrame.Position, target.part.Position)
            local speed = Config.Aimbot.Mode == "Automatic"
                and Config.Aimbot.Smoothness
                or math.clamp(Config.Aimbot.Smoothness * 1.4, 0, 1)
            Camera.CFrame = Camera.CFrame:Lerp(desired, speed)
        end
        if shouldShoot() and (now - lastShoot) >= Config.AutoShoot.Delay then
            lastShoot = now
            fireWeapon()
        end
    end
end)

scripts.summary: Infinite Ammo, Silent Aim, & Pooled Glow ESP — uses InfiniteAmmo attribute + launcher refill, hooks GunController.GetFireDirectionUnspread via require to target closest-to-crosshair custom rigs ( MercPlayers / MercPuppets ), and reus…
scripts.code:
-- [[ Rscripts Risk Notice ]]
-- This script is not verified by rscripts.net. Deal with caution.
--
-- Stay safe:
--   • Never log in on unofficial Roblox sites or lookalike domains.
--   • Real Roblox links use roblox.com (check the .com ending).
--   • Treat fake Roblox login / "claim reward" pages as phishing.
-- [[ End Rscripts Risk Notice ]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Modules = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Modules")

local GunController = require(Modules.Client.Controllers.GunController)
local CameraPOV = require(Modules.Client.CameraPOV)
local MercNpc = require(Modules.Shared.Mercs.MercNpc)

local CONFIG = {
	InfiniteAmmo = true,
	SilentAim = true,
	HitPart = "Head",
	ESP = true,
	ESPColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60),
	ESPFillTransparency = 1,
	ESPOutlineTransparency = 0,
}

if CONFIG.InfiniteAmmo then
	LocalPlayer:SetAttribute("InfiniteAmmo", true)
	LocalPlayer:GetAttributeChangedSignal("InfiniteAmmo"):Connect(function()
		if LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("InfiniteAmmo") ~= true then
			LocalPlayer:SetAttribute("InfiniteAmmo", true)
		end
	end)

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local rounds = GunController._launcherRounds
		if rounds then
			if rounds.tube and rounds.tube < 1 then
				rounds.tube = 1
			end
			if rounds.vest and rounds.vest < 99 then
				rounds.vest = 99
			end
		end
	end)
end

local rigs = {}
local rigSeen = {}
local partCache = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local cachedMercPlayers = nil
local cachedPuppetFolder = nil

local function isLocalRig(model)
	if model:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId") == LocalPlayer.UserId then
		return true
	end
	if LocalPlayer.Character and model == LocalPlayer.Character then
		return true
	end
	return false
end

local function isAlive(model)
	if not model or not model.Parent then
		return false
	end
	if model:GetAttribute("Dead") == true then
		return false
	end
	local hum = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if hum and hum.Health <= 0 then
		return false
	end
	return true
end

local function getTargetPart(model)
	local cached = partCache[model]
	if cached and cached.Parent and cached:IsDescendantOf(model) then
		return cached
	end
	local part = model:FindFirstChild(CONFIG.HitPart, true)
	if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
		partCache[model] = part
		return part
	end
	if model.PrimaryPart then
		partCache[model] = model.PrimaryPart
		return model.PrimaryPart
	end
	local fallback = model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	if fallback then
		partCache[model] = fallback
	end
	return fallback
end

local function addRig(model)
	if model and model:IsA("Model") and not rigSeen[model] and not isLocalRig(model) and isAlive(model) then
		rigSeen[model] = true
		table.insert(rigs, model)
	end
end

local function refreshRigs()
	table.clear(rigs)
	table.clear(rigSeen)

	if not cachedMercPlayers or not cachedMercPlayers.Parent then
		cachedMercPlayers = workspace:FindFirstChild("MercPlayers")
	end
	if cachedMercPlayers then
		for _, rig in cachedMercPlayers:GetChildren() do
			addRig(rig)
		end
	end

	if not cachedPuppetFolder or not cachedPuppetFolder.Parent then
		cachedPuppetFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild(MercNpc.PUPPET_FOLDER)
	end
	if cachedPuppetFolder then
		for _, npc in cachedPuppetFolder:GetChildren() do
			addRig(npc)
		end
	end

	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character then
			addRig(player.Character)
		end
	end

	return rigs
end

local function getClosestTarget()
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not cam then
		return nil
	end

	local vp = cam.ViewportSize
	local cx = vp.X * 0.5
	local cy = vp.Y * 0.5
	local bestPart = nil
	local bestDist = math.huge

	for _, model in refreshRigs() do
		local part = getTargetPart(model)
		if part then
			local screenPos, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
			if onScreen and screenPos.Z > 0 then
				local dx = screenPos.X - cx
				local dy = screenPos.Y - cy
				local dist = dx * dx + dy * dy
				if dist < bestDist then
					bestDist = dist
					bestPart = part
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return bestPart
end

local origGetFireDirectionUnspread = GunController.GetFireDirectionUnspread

GunController.GetFireDirectionUnspread = function(self)
	if CONFIG.SilentAim and not self.IsPuppet then
		local muzzleCF = self:GetActiveProjectileMuzzleWorldCFrame()
		local origin = (muzzleCF and muzzleCF.Position) or CameraPOV.GetEyePosition()
		local targetPart = getClosestTarget()
		if targetPart then
			local delta = targetPart.Position - origin
			if delta.Magnitude > 0.001 then
				return delta.Unit
			end
		end
	end
	return origGetFireDirectionUnspread(self)
end

if CONFIG.ESP then
	local ok, coreGui = pcall(function()
		return game:GetService("CoreGui")
	end)
	local espParent = (ok and coreGui) or LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
	local espFolder = espParent:FindFirstChild("GlowESP")
	if not espFolder then
		espFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
		espFolder.Name = "GlowESP"
		espFolder.Parent = espParent
	end

	local activeHighlights = {}
	local hlPool = {}
	local espSeen = {}
	local toRelease = {}

	local function acquireHighlight(model)
		local hl = table.remove(hlPool)
		if not hl then
			hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
			hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
			hl.FillColor = CONFIG.ESPColor
			hl.FillTransparency = CONFIG.ESPFillTransparency
			hl.OutlineColor = CONFIG.ESPColor
			hl.OutlineTransparency = CONFIG.ESPOutlineTransparency
			hl.Parent = espFolder
		end
		hl.Adornee = model
		hl.Enabled = true
		activeHighlights[model] = hl
	end

	local function releaseHighlight(model)
		local hl = activeHighlights[model]
		if hl then
			hl.Enabled = false
			hl.Adornee = nil
			activeHighlights[model] = nil
			table.insert(hlPool, hl)
		end
	end

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		table.clear(espSeen)
		table.clear(toRelease)

		for _, model in refreshRigs() do
			espSeen[model] = true
			if not activeHighlights[model] then
				acquireHighlight(model)
			end
		end

		for model in activeHighlights do
			if not espSeen[model] then
				table.insert(toRelease, model)
			end
		end

		for i = 1, #toRelease do
			releaseHighlight(toRelease[i])
		end
	end)
end

local RS, Players = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"), game:GetService("Players")
local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
local state = RS:WaitForChild("GrinsworthState")
local parent = (gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")

local COLORS = {
  Dormant = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 140), Gone = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 140), Away = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 140),
  Prowl = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 60),       -- wandering
  Investigate = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 30), -- heard something
  Search = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 30),      -- lost you, looking
  Chase = Color3.fromRGB(255, 40, 40),        -- after someone
  Locker = Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 255),      -- at a locker
  Kill = Color3.fromRGB(150, 0, 0),
  Stunned = Color3.fromRGB(60, 200, 255),     -- safe window
  Scripted = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
}
local STUD_M = 0.28 -- 1 stud ≈ 0.28 m

local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
hl.FillTransparency = 0.6; hl.OutlineTransparency = 0; hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
hl.Parent = parent
local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, 50); bb.AlwaysOnTop = true; bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 6, 0); bb.Parent = parent
local label = Instance.new("TextLabel", bb)
label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1); label.BackgroundTransparency = 1; label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
label.TextSize = 15; label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2

while getgenv().GESP do
  local model = workspace:FindFirstChild("GrinsworthBody") and workspace.GrinsworthBody:FindFirstChild("Grinsworth")
  local body = model and model:FindFirstChild("Body")
  local st = state:GetAttribute("State") or "?"
  local col = COLORS[st] or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
  local pivot = state:GetAttribute("Pivot")
  local pos = body and body.Position or (typeof(pivot) == "CFrame" and pivot.Position)
  local me = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

  hl.Adornee = model; hl.FillColor = col; hl.OutlineColor = col
  bb.Adornee = body; bb.Enabled = body ~= nil
  local dist = (pos and me) and (pos - me.Position).Magnitude * STUD_M
  local target = state:GetAttribute("Target")
  local onMe = target == lp.UserId and "  ← YOU" or ""
  label.TextColor3 = col
  label.Text = ("%s%s%s\n%s"):format(st, state:GetAttribute("Rampage") and " (RAMPAGE)" or "", onMe, dist and ("%.0f m"):format(dist) or "")
  task.wait(0.1)
end
hl:Destroy(); bb:Destroy()

local MONSTERS = {
  {name = "Grinsworth", folders = {"GrinsworthBody"}, stateObj = "GrinsworthState", stateKey = "State", posKeys = {"Pivot"}},
  {name = "Grinsworth (vent)", folders = {"DuctLurk"}, fixedState = "Lurk"},
  {name = "Hollow", folders = {"HollowBody"}, stateObj = "HollowState", stateKey = "State", posKeys = {"Pivot", "VentPos"}},
  {name = "Clutch", folders = {"ClutchBody"}, stateObj = "ClutchState", stateKey = "Mode", posKeys = {"VentPos"}},
  {name = "Hush", folders = {"HushBody"}, fixedState = "Present", color = CYAN},
}

local made = {}
local function track(inst) table.insert(made, inst) return inst end
local function newTag(color)
  local anchor = track(Instance.new("Part"))
  anchor.Anchored, anchor.CanCollide, anchor.CanQuery, anchor.CanTouch, anchor.Transparency = true, false, false, false, 1
  anchor.Size = Vector3.one; anchor.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera
  local bb = track(Instance.new("BillboardGui"))
  bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(240, 54); bb.AlwaysOnTop = true; bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 5, 0); bb.Adornee = anchor; bb.Parent = guiParent
  local l = Instance.new("TextLabel", bb)
  l.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1); l.BackgroundTransparency = 1; l.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold; l.TextSize = 15; l.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
  return {anchor = anchor, bb = bb, label = l}
end
local tags, highlights = {}, {}
local function highlightFor(model)
  local h = highlights[model]
  if not h or not h.Parent then
    h = track(Instance.new("Highlight")); h.FillTransparency = 0.6; h.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
    h.Adornee = model; h.Parent = guiParent; highlights[model] = h
  end
  return h
end

while getgenv().MESP do
  local me = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  local seenModels = {}
  for _, m in ipairs(MONSTERS) do
    local st = m.stateObj and RS:FindFirstChild(m.stateObj)
    local state = m.fixedState or (st and st:GetAttribute(m.stateKey)) or "?"
    if st and st:GetAttribute("Hidden") then state = state .. " (hidden)" end
    if st and st:GetAttribute("Rampage") then state = state .. " RAMPAGE" end
    local onMe = st and st:GetAttribute("Target") == lp.UserId
    local color = m.color or STATE_COLOR[state:match("^%a+")] or WHITE

    -- bodies (Hush can have several)
    local bodies = {}
    for _, fname in ipairs(m.folders) do
      local f = workspace:FindFirstChild(fname)
      if f then for _, c in ipairs(f:GetChildren()) do if c:IsA("Model") then table.insert(bodies, c) end end end
    end
    -- fallback position from the server's attributes (e.g. while in a vent)
    local fallback
    if #bodies == 0 and st and m.posKeys and not (state:find("Away") or state:find("Dormant") or state:find("Gone")) then
      for _, k in ipairs(m.posKeys) do
        local v = st:GetAttribute(k)
        local p = typeof(v) == "CFrame" and v.Position or typeof(v) == "Vector3" and v
        if p and p.Magnitude > 1 then fallback = p break end
      end
    end

    local points = {}
    for _, b in ipairs(bodies) do
      seenModels[b] = true
      local h = highlightFor(b); h.FillColor, h.OutlineColor = color, color
      table.insert(points, b:GetPivot().Position)
    end
    if fallback then table.insert(points, fallback) end

    tags[m] = tags[m] or {}
    for i, pos in ipairs(points) do
      local t = tags[m][i] or newTag(); tags[m][i] = t
      t.anchor.Position = pos; t.bb.Enabled = true
      local dist = me and (pos - me.Position).Magnitude * STUD_M
      t.label.TextColor3 = color
      t.label.Text = ("%s · %s%s%s\n%s"):format(m.name, state, onMe and "  ← YOU" or "", (fallback and pos == fallback) and " (vent)" or "", dist and ("%.0f m"):format(dist) or "")
    end
    for i = #points + 1, #tags[m] do tags[m][i].bb.Enabled = false end
  end
  for model, h in pairs(highlights) do if not seenModels[model] then h:Destroy(); highlights[model] = nil end end
  task.wait(0.1)
end
for _, i in ipairs(made) do pcall(function() i:Destroy() end) end
